headings.text: Mosheh in Horeb ah Yahweh’ Thuciamna Sutkik

verses.text: Hihte pen Yardan nisuahna lam gamlak, Suph tawh kilehngat lam Arabah gam sung, Paran leh Tophel, Laban Hazeroth leh Dizahab kikalah Mosheh in Israyl mi khempeuh tunga a gen Thukhamte ahi hi.
(Tua mun pen Horeb panin Seir Mual tawnin Kadesh Barnea lamah ni sawm le ni khat paina lam ahi hi.)
Egypt a nusiat zawh uh a kum 40-na sung, kha sawm le kha khat kha, tua kha a ni masa ni-in Mosheh in Israyl mite tungah Yahweh in amaute tawh kisai-in thupiaksa khempeuh a tangko hi.
Hih pen Heshbon gam sung teng a uk Amor mite’ kumpipa Sihon a zawh khit, Ashtoroth gam sung teng a uk Bashan mite’ kumpipa Og pen Edrei ah a zawh khit cianga thu ahi hi.
Moab gam leitang tung Yardan hih lam pangah Mosheh in hih Thukham hilhcian ding kipanin a gen inah:
“Horeb mual tungah Yahweh i Pa in eite tungah hong gen inah: Hih mual ah sauvei na omkhinzo uh hi.

Kithawi-in Amor mite’ mual tung gam ah dingkhia un. Arabah gam veng mite khempeuh, mual tung gamte, ni tumna lam mual bulte, Negev gam sung leh tuipi gei, Canaan mite gam, Lebanon leh Euphrates Gun Lian dongah pai un.
En un, note mai-ah leitang ka koihzo hi. Tu-in pai unla, Yahweh in na pate uh Abraham, Isaac, Yaaqob leh amau khita amau’ suanlekhakte tungah piak dingin a ciamsa leitang luah un, hong ci hi.
Tua hun laitakin note kiangah kong gen inah: note’ vangik pen kei guak in ka pua zo kei hi, kong ci hi.
Yahweh na Pa un note tampi hong phasakkhin a, hih lai ah tuni-in note, vantunga aksi phazah tawh na kibang uh hi.
Yahweh, na pate uh Vanglian Vantung Pa in tu-a zah tulin a tamzaw-in note hong bawl henla, Amah in hong ciamsa bangin note thupha hong pia tahen!
Ahih hangin note’ thunawngkaite leh na vangikte, note’ nialnate khempeuh kei guak in bangci bangin pua zo ding ka hi hiam?
Na minamte lak panun a pil, a thuthei, leh thu ngaihsun thei mite teel unla, note’ tungah keimah in amaute ka koih ding hi, kong ci hi.
note in keimah hong dawngin, ‘Nangmah in kote tunga nong gen thu pen kote in ka sep dingun a kilawm thu ahi hi,’ nong ci uh hi.

Tua ahih manin na minamte’ maikai pilin thu a ngaihsun thei mite ka la a, note tungah lutang in amaute ka koih hi—a tultul ukte, a zaza a ukte, sawmngate a ukte, a sawmsawmin a ukte leh minam uliante ahi uh hi.

Tua hun lai-in keimah in vapuak la-in, na thukhente uh thu ka pia a, ‘Na sanggamte uh kikala thu kineihte za unla, mi khat leh a sanggampa kikal ahih keileh mi khat leh amah tawh a om peemta khat kikalah thuman tak leh siangtho takin thu na khen un.

Thukhenna ah angvan tuan na nei peuhmah kei ding uh hi. Mi liante mah bangin mi neute’ thu zong na ngai ding uh a, note in mi khatpeuh zong na lau kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh na zat uh thukhenna pen Yahweh’ thukhenna ahi hi. Note aa dingin a haksa mahmah thute ka kiangah hong paipih unla, keimah in tua thu ka za ding hi,’ kong ci hi.
Tua hun lai-in na hih ding uh nate khempeuh note ka hong gen hi.

Tua ahih manin Yahweh in eite hong thupiaksa bangin Horeb panin i dingkhia a, Amor mite’ mual tung gam zuatna lamkala na muhsa a lian a lauhuai mahmah sehnel gam i nawk hi. Tua khit ciangin Kadesh Barnea ah eite i tung hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in note kiangah, ‘Yahweh eite Pa in hong piak Amor mite’ mual tung gam ah na tungkhin uh a,

tu-in en un, Yahweh note Pa in note mai-ah tua gam koihkhin hi. Pai unla, na pate uh Vanglian Pa Yahweh in note hong hilhsa bang teekteekin amau’ neihsa luah un. Lau kei unla, lungkia kei un,’ kong ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin na vekpi-un ka kiangah nong pai uh a, ‘Eite aa dingin gam va enin, i paitoh nading lampi leh i zuat ding khuapite hong genkik thei ding eite’ mai-ah mi sawl ni,’ nong ci uh hi.
Tua geelna thu uh hoih ka sa a, tua ahih manin na mite uh minam khat panin khatta, mi sawm le mi nih ka tengkhia hi.
Amaute dingkhia-in mual tungte ah paito-in Eshcol Kuam ah tung uh a, tua teng va kankhia sim uh hi.
Amaute in tua gam gahte pawlkhat hong pua-in eite kiangah hong paipih uh a, ‘Yahweh i Pa in eite hong piak gam pen leitang hoih ahi hi,’ ci-in thu hong puakkik uh hi.
Tua bang hi napi-in note na paito nuam kei uh hi. Note in Yahweh na Pa uh thupiak na nial uh a,
na puanbuk sungte uh ah phunin, ‘Yahweh in eite hong mudah ahih manin eite hong susiamang dingin Amor mite khut sungah hong pia dingin Egypt gam panin eite hong paikhiatpih ahi hi.

Eite koi lai-ah pai ding i hi hiam? I sanggamte in eite hong lungkiasakzo a, ‘Eite sangin mite lianzaw-in sangzaw uh hi. A khuapite uh lianin van banin a muanhuai hi. Tua lai mun ah Anak’ suante zong ka mu uh hi,’ hong ci hi,’ na ci uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin keimah in note kiangah, ‘Lipkhap kei un. Amaute thembeek zong lau kei un.
Na mai uh ah Yahweh note Vantung Pa pai hi. Note mit muhin Egypt gam sungah note aa dingin Amah in a hih bangin note aa dingin Amah in hong dosak ding hi.
Note hih mun dong na tun matengun pa in a tapa a puak bangin sehnel gam sung na paina uh lam tawntung ah Yahweh na Pa un note hong puakna na muhsa uh ahi hi,’ kong ci hi.
Hih khempeuh khit nangawn ah note in Yahweh na Pa uh na um kei uh a,
na puanbukte na phuh nading uh note aa dingin mun hong zonsak ding, na pai nading uh lampi hong lak dingin zanin mei tawh sunin meii tawh hong ompih ahi Yahweh na um kei uh hi.
Yahweh in na genna uh hong za a, Amah a heh suakin kiciam a,
‘Hih a gilo khang mite khat beek in na pu na pate uh tungah ka ciamsa gam hoih na mu kha kei taktak ding uh a,
Yephunneh’ tapa Caleb bek in tua gam mu ding hi; amah in a lungsim khempeuh tawh Yahweh zui ahih manin amah leh a tate tungah ama totsa leitang ka pia ding hi!’ a ci hi.
Note hangin keima tungah zong Yahweh lungkim loin hong gen a, ‘Nang nangawn zong na lut kha tuan kei ding a,
ahih hangin na kianga nang hong huh dinga a ding Nun’ tapa Yahshua pen tua gam sungah lut kha ding hi. Amah hanthawn in; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in Israyl mite tua gam luahsak ding hi.
Galmat suak ding hi na cih uh a neupente, a sia panin a pha cih a khentel thei nai lo na tate uh, tua gam lut ding uh hi. Keimah in amaute tungah ka pia ding a, amaute in tua gam luah ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin note na hih uh leh, kihei unla, Tuipi San lam manawhin sehnel gam sungah pai un,’ hong ci hi.

Tua khit ciangin note in dawngin keima tungah, ‘Yahweh’ tungah ka mawhkhin uh hi! Yahweh in a thupiaksa bangin kote paito-in ka do ding uh hi,’ nong ci uh hi. Tua ahih manin na milipun na galhiam uh tawh na kithawi uh a, mual tung gam ah paitoh ding na baih ngaihsut uh hi.

Ahih hangin Yahweh in keima kiangah, ‘Amaute kiangah gen in: Paito kei unla, zong do kei un; bang hang hiam cihleh Keimah in note kong ompih kei a, na galte mai-ah note hong kizogawp ding hi,’ hong ci hi.
Tua ahih manin keimah in note kong hilhkhol a, ahih hangin note in ka thu na ngai loin, note in Yahweh’ thupiakna nialin, kipum muan gawpin leh no thubek thusa-in mual tung gam ah na paito uh hi.
Tua ciangin mual tung gam sunga teng Amor mite in note langpangin hong kuan uh a, khuai hon hawl bangin Seir panin Hormah dong ah note hong lehhawlkhiat uh hi.
Note hong ciahkikin Yahweh mai-ah na kap uh a, ahih hangin Yahweh in note’ kahna hong ngai lo a, a bil hong humsan hi.
Tua ahih manin Kadesh ah ni tampi na khawl uh a, na hun khempeuh uh tua lai ah a mawk bei hi.
Tua khit ciangin eite kilehkikin, Yahweh in keimah hong hilhna bangin Tuipi San lam zuatna sehnel gam sungah i pai a, ni tampi sung Seir Mual tung gam kiim ah i pai kawikawi hi.
Yahweh in keima kiangah hong gen inah:
‘Hih mual kiimah sauvei khop na paikhinta uh hi; leilu lamah kihei un.
Mite zong thupia inla, ‘Seir gama a teng Esau’ suanlekhakte ahi na sanggamte uh gam sung a nawk ding na hita uh hi. Amaute in note hong kihta ding uh a, tua ahih manin nomau mah kidawmtawm un.

Amaute a do dingin phuangkhia kei un; bang hang hiam cihleh Keimah in amaute’ gam khatbeek zong note kong pia kei ding a, Keimah in a luah dingin Seir Mual pen Esau tungah piakhin ka hih manin khepek khat ngakna khop nangawn zong kong pia kei ding hi.
Na nek uh an hangin amaute tungah sum na pia ding uh a, na dawn uh tui hangin sum na pia ding uh hi.

Na khutte uh tawh na sepna khempeuh uh ah Yahweh note Pa in thupha hong pia hi. Hih azai sehnel gam tawntunga na paina uh ah Amah in hong kem hong cing hi. Hih kum 40 sung Yahweh note Pa in hong ompih a, na kisap uh bangmah a om kei hi,’ ci-in gen in,’ hong ci hi.

Tua ahih manin Seir gam sunga a teng Esau suanlekhakte ahi i sanggamte khengin i pai hi. Elath leh Ezion Geber panin a kahto Arabah lam lianpi panin eite i kihei a, Moab sehnel gam lamdung ah i pai hi.

Tua tak ciangin Yahweh in keima kiangah, ‘Moab mite nawngkaisak kei unla, amaute a do dingin zong phuangkhia se kei un; bang hang hiam cihleh Lot’ suanlekhakte tungah a luah dingin Keimah in Ar gam piakhin ka hih manin na luah dingun amau’ gam khatbeek zong ka hong pia kei ding hi.
(A beisa hun tampi lai-in Emim mite na teng ngeikhin uh hi. Amaute pen Anak mite bangin thahatin, tamin, a tunsang mite ahi uh hi.
Amaute pen Anak mite mah bangin Rephaim mite bangin kingaihsun uh hi; ahih hangin Moab mite in Emim mite ci uh hi.

Hihte khempeuh a beisa hunin Seir gam sungah na teng uh hi; ahih hangin Yahweh in Israyl mite a piak gam ah Israyl mite in a hih bangin teekteekin Esau’ suanlekhakte in amaute suankhia uh a, amaute’ mai panin susiamangin, amau’ tenna munte ah teng uh hi.)
Tu-in ding unla, Zered Kuam kantan un,’ hong ci hi. Tua ahih manin eite in Zered Kuam i kantan hi.

Amaute tungah Yahweh a kiciam bang teekteekin giahphual panin galsim mi ahi tua khangmite khempeuh a sihkhit dong ahi, Kadesh Barnea panin Zered Kuam i kantan khit dong i paina hun sungteng pen kum 38 a pha hi.
A taktakin ci le hang, giahphual panin Yahweh in amaute a suksiat khitsiang matengin Yahweh’ khut in amaute’ langah a pang ahi hi.
Tu-in mite lak panin hih galdo mite a tawpna pen dong a kisihsakmang khit ciangin,
Yahweh in keima kiangah hong gen inah:
‘Tuni-in Ar gam san tak ah Moab gam kuam a kantan ding na hi uh hi.

Ammon mite kiang nai-ah na tun uh ciangin, amaute nawngkaisak kei unla, amaute a do dingin zong phuangkhia se kei un; bang hang hiam cihleh Keimah in tua gam a luah dingin Lot’ suanlekhakte tungah piakhin ka hih manin Ammon mite gam khatbeek zong luah dingin note tungah ka hong pia kei ding hi.
(Tua gam pen zong tua lai-a a teng ngei Rephaim mite gam kici ngei hi; ahih hangin Ammon mite in Zamzummim mite ci uh hi.
Amaute pen Anak mite bangin thahatin, tamin, a tunsang mite a hi uh hi. Amaute suankhia-in amau’ tenna mun ah a teng Ammon mite’ mai panin Yahweh in amaute susia hi.
Yahweh in amaute mai panin tua mite khempeuh a suksiat ciangin Seir gam sunga teng Esau’ suanlekhakte aa dingin a kibangin Yahweh in a hih hi.
Gaza ciang dong khuaneute ah a teng Avvim mite ahih leh, Caphtor;Crete, panin hong piakhia Caphtor mite in amaute susia-in amau’ tenna mun ah a teng uh hi.)

Ding un, na khualzin dingin kithawikhia unla, Arnon Gun kantan un. En un, Heshbon kumpipa ahi Amor mi Sihon leh ama gam, note khut sungah kong piakhin hi. Gam sung neihsa teng a la dingin kipan unla, amah tawh gal sungah kido un.

Vantung buppi nuai-a gamte khempeuh tungah note hong kilauna leh hong kikihtakna koih dingin tu ni-in Keimah ka kipan ding hi. Amaute in note’ thu a kipuakna za ding uh a, note hangin amaute lau-in lingin lungkhamna lianpi sungah om ding uh hi.
Kedemoth Sehnel gam panin Heshbon kumpipa Sihon kiangah Keimah in kilemna kammalte tawh ka kamtaite sawlin,
‘Na gam sung hong nawksak in. Lampi bekah ka pai ding uh a, taklam ahi a, veilam ah ahi zongin ka pial kei ding uh hi.
Nangmah in kote kiangah nek ding an leh dawn ding tui na hong zuak ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tuate pen sum manh ahi hi. Khe tawh hong nawksak bek in.

Yahweh ka Pa un kote hong piakna gam ah lutin, Yardan ka kantan matengun Seir gam sunga teng Esau’ suanlekhakte leh Ar gam sunga teng Moab mite bang teekteekin na gam ka nawk ding uh hong phal in,’ ka cisak ding hi,’ a ci hi.

Ahih hangin Heshbon kumpipa Sihon in eite a sung tawnin hong nawksak nuam lo hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tu ni-a bangin note’ khut sungah Yahweh in amah hong piak theih nadingin Yahweh na Pa un ama lungsim khauhsakin a lungtang a genhaksak ding hi.
Yahweh in keima kiangah, ‘En in, note tungah Sihon leh ama gam piak dingin ka kipankhin hi. Ama gam luah theih nadingin hawlkhiat ding leh luah ding kipan in,’ hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin Sihon leh a mite khempeuh in eite langah hong do dingin Yatzah ah hong tung uh hi.
Yahweh i Pa in eite tungah amah hong pia a, eite in amah, a tapate leh ama mite khempeuh i zo hi.
Tua hun lai-in eite in ama khuapite khempeuh i la a, khuapi khempeuh-a pasal, numei leh naupang a vekpi-in i susia maimang hi. Eite in mihing khat zong i hingkhawi kei hi.
Ahih hangin i laksa khuapite panin ganhonte leh vante i siit a, eite aa dingin tuate i la hi.
Arnon Gun nawla om Aroer pan leh tua kuam sung khuapi panin Gilead ciang dong khuapi khat zong eite aa dingin a thahat lua om lo hi. Yahweh i Pa in eite tungah tuate khempeuh hong pia hi.
Ahih hangin Ammon mite’ gam nai-ah note na pai kei uh a, Yabbok Gun dung mun khatpeuh ahi a, mual tungte-a khuapite ah ahi a, Yahweh i Pa in hong khamna mun peuhpeuh ah ahi zongin i pai kei hi.
Tua khit ciangin eite kihei-in Bashan lam paina lampi ah i paito hi; Bashan kumpipa Og pen ama galkap khempeuh tawh eite langah hong do dingin Edrei ah hong paikhia hi.

Yahweh in keima kiangah, ‘Amah lau kei in; bang hang hiam cihleh nangma khut sungah amah leh a mite khempeuh ka hong piakhin hi. Heshbon ah a teng Amor mite’ kumpipa Sihon tungah na hih bangin ama tungah na hih ding hi,’ hong ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh i Pa in Bashan kumpipa Og pen ama galkap khempeuh tawh eite’ khut sungah hong pia hi. A suakta khat zong a om nawnloh dongin eite in amah i do hi.
Tua hun lai-in eite in ama khuapite khempeuh i la hi. Bashan sunga Og’ kumpi gam ahi Argob gam buppi, khuapi 60 panin i lak loh khat zong a om kei hi.
Hih khuapite khempeuh pen kulhpi sangpipite, kulhkongpite, leh kalh sikzawlte tawh a muanhuai mahmah hi a, kulh a nei lo khua neuneu tampitak zong tua lai ah a om hi.
Khuapi khempeuh panin pasal peuhmah, numei peuhmah leh naupang peuhmah thatin Heshbon kumpipa Sihon tungah i hih bangin, eite in amaute a vekpi-in i susia mang dikdek hi.
Ahih hangin a khuapite uh panin ganhon khempeuh leh vante, ei aa dingin i la hi.
Arnon Gun panin Hermon Mual dong ah Amor mite’ kumpi hih tenih kiang panin Yardan hih lam panga gam eite in i la hi.
(Sidon mite in Hermon pen Sirion ci a, Amor mite in tua pen Senir ci uh hi)
Zanggam-a om khuapite khempeuh leh Gilead gam khempeuh, Bashan khempeuh, Salecah leh Edrei dong, Bashan-a om Og’ kumpi gam khuapite i la hi.

(Rephaim mite lakah a omlai sun Bashan kumpipa Og bek ahi hi. Ama lupna pen sik tawh a kibawl hi a, cubit kua sau-in cubit li zai hi; tua pen pi 13 sang sauzaw thei ding a, pi 6 zai hi. Tua pen Ammon mite’ khua Rabbah ah om lai hi.)
Tua hun lai-in i luah gam—Arnon Gun kianga Aroer’ leilu lam gam, Gilead mual tung gam alang zong kihelin ama khuapite tawh i luah gam—keimah in Reuben mite leh Gad mite tungah ka pia hi.
Gilead gam adang teng leh a khuapite, leh Og’ kumpi gam Bashan khempeuh, Menasheh minam alangte tungah ka pia hi. (Bashan-a Argob gamkuam buppi pen Rephaim-te gamin a kithei nei ahi hi.)

Menasheh’ suanlekhak ahi Yair in Argob gamhuam buppi, Geshur mite leh Maacath mite’ gamgi dong la hi. Tua pen ama min tamsak ahih manin tu ni dongin Bashan pen Havvoth Yair kici hi; Yair mite’ Tennate a cihna ahi hi.
Keimah in Machir tungah Gilead ka pia hi.
Ahih hangin Reuben mite leh Gad mite tungah Gilead panin Arnon Gun dong (gamgi-a omlai gun laizang), Ammon mite’ gamgi-a om Yabbok Gun dong ah gam ka pia hi.
A ni tumna lam gamgi pen Arabah gam sunga Yardan, Kinnereth(Galilee) panin Pisgah mualpang nuai-a Arabah Tuipi(Tuipi Si) dong ahi hi.

Tua hun lai-in keimah in note thu kong pia a, ‘Yahweh note Pa in luah dingin hih gam hong piazo hi. Na galdo mite khempeuh uh galhiam tawh kithawi-in Israyl mi na sanggamte uh mai-ah va kuan ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin na zite, na tate, leh na gankhawite(gankhawi tampitak na neihna uh ka thei hi) uh keimah in note tungah kong piaksa na khuapite uh sungah om ding uh a,

Yahweh in note hong piak bangin na sanggamte uh a vekin a piak khit mateng, Yahweh in a piak Yardan pang langkhat lama gam a luah matengun na huh ding uh hi. Tua khit ciangin note kong piaksa ahi na neihsa ciat uh ah note khempeuh na ciahkik ding uh hi,’ kong ci hi.

Tua hun lai-in Keimah in Nun’ tapa Yahshua thu ka pia a, ‘Yahweh na Pa in hih kumpi nihte tungah a bawlna khempeuh na mite in mukhinzo hi. Yahweh in na nawkna kumpi gamte khempeuh a tua mah bangin hih ding hi.
Amaute na lau peuhmah kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh na Pa in nang aa dingin hong dosak ding hi,’ ka ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin tua hun lai-in Yahweh kiangah ka thuum a,

‘Aw Yahweh ka Pa, na nasempa tungah na liatna leh na thahatna khut, lak dingin hong kipan pan bek na hi hiam; bang hang hiam cihleh nangma hih nasep bangin a sem thei leh a vanglian gamtatna a hih thei vantung ah ahi a, leitung ah ahi zongin bang pasian om ahi hiam?
Kong thuum hi, kei hong paisak inla, Yardan pang langkhat lama gam hoih, tua mualtung gam hoih leh Lebanon hong musak in,’ ka ci hi.
Ahih hangin note hangin kei tungah Yahweh hong heh a, ka thu hong ngai lo hi. Tua ahih manin Yahweh in keima kiangah, ‘Phazo hi! Hih thu tawh kisai Kei kiangah hong gen nawn kei in!
Pisgah mual dawn ah paito inla, ni tumna lam, leilu lam, leitaw lam, leh nisuahna lamah khuadak in. Na mit tawh gal et in, ahih hangin Yardan na kantan kha kei ding hi.

Ahih hangin Nun’ tapa Yahshua za na pia ding a, amah hanthawnin tha na pia ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh hih mite mai-ah amah pai ding a, na gal muh ding gam, amah in amaute a luahsak ding hi,’ hong ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Beth Peor tawh a kigalsai kuam ah eite i taam hi.

Israyl aw, note na nuntak nading uh leh, na pate uh Vantung Pa, Yahweh in note hong piak leitang ah pai in na luah dingun note zuih ding leh hih dingin keimah in note kong hilh ngeina kipte leh thukhennate tu-in za un.
Note ka hong thupiak a thu na behlap kei ding uh a, tua panin khatpeuh zong na hemkhia kei ding uh hi; tua hileh keimah in note kong thupiak Yahweh na Pa uh Thukhamte na zui thei ding uh hi.
Yahweh in Baal Peor; Peor Topa, ah a hihna na mitte uh tawh na muhsa uh ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh Baal Peor; Peor Topa, a zui mite khempeuh Yahweh na Pa note lak panin amaute susiamang khinzo hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh na Pa uh a lenkip note khempeuh tu-in na nungta uh hi.
En un, note in a luah dingin na lutna ding uh gam sungah na zuih dingun, Yahweh ka Pa in keimah hong thupiakna bang teekteekin keimah in ngeina kipte leh thukhennate kong hilhkhinzo hi.

Tua ahih manin tuate hoih takin zui unla sem un; bang hang hiam cihleh tua pen hih ngeinate khempeuh a za minamte muhna ah na pilna uh leh na thu theihna uh hi a, amaute in, ‘Hih minam liante pen pilin a thu thei mite ahi taktak uh hi,’ hong ci ding uh hi.
Ama tungah i thuum simin Yahweh i Pa in eite hong nai zahin tua bangin, amau’ pasiante (elohim) in amaute ompihna a nei minam lian adang kua om ahi hiam?*
Tu ni-in note mai-ah ka koih hih Thukham khempeuh bangin a man ngeina kipte leh thukhennate a nei minam lian adang kua om ahi hiam?*

Nomau’ mah tua bek kilunglutsak un la, na mitte uh tawh na muhsa nate na mangngilh loh nadingin nomau mah tha sanin kikem unla, na nuntak sung tawntungun na lutang panin tuate a paikhiat loh na dingin kikem un. Na tate, na tute uh tungah tuate na hilh ding uh hi.

Amah in na pu na pate uh it ahih manin Amah in amau’ khita a suanlekhakte uh teel hi; Amah in Egypt gam panin Ama Ompihna leh Ama vanglian thahatna tawh note hong paikhiatpih a,
note sangin a tamzaw leh a thahatzaw minamte na mai panin a hawlkhia dingin leh, tu ni-a bangin note luah dingin amau’ leitang hong piakna amau gam sungah hong paipih dingin hong paikhiatpih ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh pen a tunglam vantung leh nuailam leitunga om Pa ahihna tu ni-in thei unla, na lungtang tungah ciamteh un. Adang kuamah om lo hi.

Tua ahih manin note leh note khita na tate uh tawh thu hoih ahih nading leh a tawntunga dingin Yahweh na Pa un note tungah hong piak gam ah saupi na nuntak theihna dingun Ama ngeina kipte leh tu ni-in keimah in note tungah thu kong piak Ama Thukhamte na zui ding uh hi” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Mosheh in ni suah khiatna lam, Yardan hih lampang ah khuapi thum tuamkoih a,

muhdahna hangin sawmkholhna tawh hi loin amah in sawm lo pi-in a sanggampa a that khak leh mi khat a thatkha peuhmah tua lai mun ah tai thei ding uh a, hih khuapite khat ah taina tawh ama nuntakna suakta thei ding hi.

Hih pen Mosheh in Israyl mite mai-ah a koih Thukham ahi hi:
Hihte pen Israyl mite tungah Mosheh in a gen tecipannate, ngeina kipte, leh thukhennate ahi hi— Egypt gam panin amaute a paikhiat khit ciang leh,

Egypt gam panin amaute a paikhiatin Mosheh leh Israyl mite in a zogawp uh Heshbon gam a uk Amor mite’ kumpipa Sihon’ gam sung Yardan nisuahna lam, Beth Peor nai-a kuam ah amaute a tun ciangun a gente ahi hi.

Mosheh in Israyl-te khempeuh samsakin, amaute kiangah, “Israyl-te aw, tuni-a note zakin kong gen ngeina kipte leh thukhennate note in na theih nadingin za unla, tuate limtakin zui unla hih un.
Yahweh i Pa in eite tawh Horeb ah thuciamna khat bawl hi;

Tua hun lai-in Yahweh’ Thukham note tungah a genkhia dingin Yahweh leh note kikal ah keimah ka ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh note in meikuang na kihta uh a, mual tungah na kahto kei uh hi; Amah in,
‘Kei pen Yahweh note Pa, salsuahna inn sung pan, Egypt gam sung panin note hong paikhiatpihpa ka hi hi.
Keima mai panin a kikham pasiante (elohim) na nei nawn kei ding uh hi.

A kiseek milim khatpeuh ahi a, tunglam vantung sunga om khatpeuh tawh a kisunin ahi a, nuai lam leitunga om khatpeuh tawh a kisunin a hi a, nuai lam tuite sunga khatpeuh tawh a kisunin ahi zongin note aa dingin na bawl kei ding uh hi;

ahih hangin Yahweh in note hong itna hang leh, Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh khut pan, salsuahna inn panin note hong tankhia ding leh vanglian khut tawh note hong paikhiatpih dingin na pu na pate uh tungah khutlapna tawh a kiciamna a letkipna hang ahi hi.

ahih hangin Amah a muhdah mite, suksiatna tawh thukkikpa ahi hi. Amah a mudah mi tungah Amah zekai lo ding a, a maitang mah ah thukkik ding hi.

Yahweh note Pa in Pharaoh tung leh Egypt gam khempeuh tungah a bawlna na phawk hamtang ding uh hi; tua ciangin note in amaute na lau nawn kei ding uh hi.

Tua bek tham loin, note kiang panin a kibu a nungta lai mite lakah Yahweh na Pa un khuaipi sawl ding ahih manin amaute nangawn kisusiamang ding hi.

Ahih hangin Yahweh na Pa un note tungah hong pia ding a, amaute a kisuksiat khit matengin natsakna tawh amaute mangthangsak ding hi.

A kihhuai khatpeuh na inn sung uh ah na pai pih peuhmah kei ding uh hi; tua bang ahih keileh tua nate mah bangin note in suksiatna dan na thuak ding uh hi. Note in tua nate mudah mahmahin na kih ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tua nate pen a kisusiamang dingin a kisamsia a tuam nate ahi hi.

Note nungta-in, tampi pha-in, Yahweh in na pate tungah kiciamna tawh a ciamsa gam ah pai-in na luah theih na dingun, tuni-in keimah in note kong piak Thukham peuhmah zui-in na gamtat nadingun na ngaihsun ding uh hi.

Ama Thukhamte na zui nuam uh hiam, na zui nuam kei uh hiam cih a theih nading; na kiniamkhiat theih na ding, hong ze-et theih na dingin, hong laktel theih nading leh na lungtang sung uh ah bang om hiam cih a theih nadingin hih kum 40 sung sehnel gam sung, lam tawntungah Yahweh na Pa un note hong paipihna na phawk gige ding uh hi.

Tua ahih manin Amah in note hong niamkhiatin, na gil uh a kial dingin hong phalin, note in na theih loh uh na pu na pate in zong a theih lo uh manna tawh hong vaak hi; tua ahih manin Amah in, ‘Anlum bek tawh mihing nungta loin, Yahweh’ kamsung panin hong pusuakkhia kammal khempeuh tawh nungta hi,’ cih note hong theisak hi.
Hih kum 40 sung, note tunga na puante uh luigawp lo ding a, na khete uh zong bawk gawp lo ding hi.
Mi khat in a tapa a thuhilh bangin Yahweh na Pa un note hong thuhilhna na lungsim sung uh ah thei un.
Tua ahih manin Amah zahtakna-in Ama lampite zuihna tawh Yahweh na Pa uh Thukhamte na zui gige ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh na Pa un gam hoih ah note hong paipih hi; tua gam pen luituite a luanna, tuikhukte a omna, mual leh guam ah a luang ciktui a phulna,
mangbuh leh mangbuhham, leengguite leh theikungte, mang kawlsingte a om na gam, olive sathau leh khuaizu a omna gam,
na kham takun an na nek na ding uh gam leh bangmah na kisap loh nading mun, a suangte sik tawh a kibawl ahihna gam leh a mualte pen sumsan kitawhna gam ahi hi.
Note in ne-in na gil uh a vah ciangin, Yahweh in gam hoih hong piakna hangin Yahweh na Pa uh na phat ding uh hi.
Tu ni-in keimah in note kong piak Ama Thukhamte, Ama thukhennate, Ama ngeina kipte zuih lohna tawh Yahweh na Pa uh na mangngilh loh nadingun kidawm mahmah un;
Tua hi keileh an ne-in na kham uh ciang, inn hoihte lamin tuate sungah na om uh ciang,
na bawnghonte uhleh na tuuhonte uh tampi a phak ciang, na ngun leh na kham uh tampi pha-in, na neih khempeuh uh tampi a phak ciangin,
note na kisathei ding uh a, salsuahna inn pan, Egypt gam panin hong paikhiatpih Yahweh na Pa uh na mangngilh ding uh hi,
Amah pen a lian a lipkhaphuai sehnel gam ah gul gunei leh mommai lak leh tui om lohna lei keu ah a hong paipihpa, meisuang tawh a kibang suangpi panin tui hong piapa,

hun nunung lam ciangin note ading a hoih theih nadingin note hongniamkhiatin a hong ze-etin, hong telciansak theih nadingin na pu na pate un a theih loh manna tawh sehnel gam sung ah a hong vakpa ahi hi.

Ahih hangin tu ni-a mah bangin na pu na pate uh tungah kiciamna tawh a ciam Ama thuciamna hih bangin a kipsak theih nadingin, na hauh nadingun thahatna hong pia Yahweh note Vantung Pa ahihna na phawk gige ding uh hi.

Khat peuhpeuh hangin note in a na a sem ding leh a bia dingin a kikham Pasiante’ (Elohim) nungzuihna tawh Yahweh na Pa uh na mangngilh uh leh, note hong kisusia taktak ding hi, ci-in tu ni-in note langah keimah in a manna genin teci pang ka hi hi.
Yahweh na Pa uh thu mang lo na hih manun, note mai-a Yahweh in a suksiat minamte bang teekteekin note na siamang ding uh hi.
Israyl-te aw, za un; tuni-in note in Yardan na kantan ding uh a, van a ban kulhpi a nei khuapi liante-a a teng, note sangin tawmzaw-in a thahatzaw minamte a hawlkhia dingin na pai ding uh hi.
Tua mite pen thahatin thasang uh a, ‘Anak suanlekhakte kua in langpan zo ding ahi hiam?’ ci-in na theihsa uh leh na zaksa uh Anak mite’ suanlekhakte ahi uh hi.

Ahih hangin a kangtum thei meikuang bangin note mai-ah a paipa pen Yahweh note Pa ahihna tuni-in theitel un. Yahweh in keima kiangah, ‘Hih mite ka mukhin a, a lungsim khauh mite ahi taktak uh hi!

Na tate uh pen a theisa a kihilh ngeikhinsa ahih lohna phawk un; tua thute inah: Yahweh na Pa uh thuhilhna, Ama liatna, Ama vanglian khut, a kizankhia Ama khut,
Egypt gam sunga Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh leh a leitang khempeuh-a a bawl Ama limte leh Ama sepnate;

hih mun ah na tun matengun sehnel gam sungah note aa dingin Ama hihnate;

Tua pen Yahweh na Pa un a don leitang ahi hi. Kum kipat panin kum bei dong ah Yahweh na Pa uh mittangte in tua gam en gige tawntung hi.

tua ciangin Keimah in note leitang aa dingin a hun sungin guah masa leh guah nunung kong pia ding hi; tua hileh na ante uh, na leenggah thakte uh leh na sathau-te uh na kaikhawm thei ding uh hi.

tua ahih manin Yahweh in na pu na pate tungah piak dingin a ciam gam sungah, leitung’ tung vantunga hunte bangin note nuntak hunte leh na tate uh nuntak hunte saupi hi ding hi.
Yahweh na Pa uh it theihna ding, Ama lampite khempeuh zuih theihna ding, Amah kiplet theih nadingin, zuih dingin note tungah kong piak hih thukhamte khempeuh limtakin zui-in na gamtat uh leh,
Na mai panin hih minamte khempeuh Yahweh in hawlkhia ding a, note sangin tamzaw-in a thahatzaw minamte na suankhia ding uh hi.
Na khe un a sikna mun peuhpeuh nomau aa hi ding hi; sehnel gam panin Lebanon dong, Euphrates Gun panin Ni tumna lam Tuipi (Mediterranean Tuipi) dong hi ding hi.

Tu ni-in note kong piak Yahweh na Pa uh Thukhamte na zuih uh leh, thupha hi a,
tua ahih keileh, Yahweh na Pa uh Thukhamte zui loin, note in na theih nai loh uh pasiante (elohim, teraphim) nungzui dingin note mai-a ka koih ngeina panin na pial uh leh, samsiatna ahi hi.

Hihte pen, leitung ah na nuntak laiteng uh Yahweh, na pu na pate uh Vantung Pa in luah dingin note hong piakna gam sungah pel loin na zuih ding uh leh na hih ding uh ngeina kipte leh thukhennate ahi hi.
Mual sang tungte tung, mual dawn leh singkung nuai tenga amau’ pasiante a bia, note in na hawlkhiat ding uh minamte omna mun khempeuh pel loin na susia maimang ding uh hi.

Note in amau’ biaknataute pel loin na susia ding uh a, a thupit ngaihsut uh khuampite; Baal ni-pasian milimte, na phukpai ding uh a, a thupit ngaihsut uh khuampite; Asherah khuampite, na haltum ding uh hi. Amau pasiante (elohim, teraphim) ahi milimte na phukpai ding uh a, tua munte panin amau minte na maimangsak ding uh hi.
Tua bang dante tawh Yahweh na Pa uh na bia peuhmah kei ding uh hi; Yahweh na Pa uh pen pasian (el) hi lo hi.
Yahweh na Pa un Ama Min a phuh nadingin beh khempeuh sung panin a teelkhiatna mun ahi na Pa uh omna na zong ding uh a, tua lai mun ah pel loin na pai ding uh hi.

Tua lai mun ah na meihal biaknate leh biakpiaknate, sawm-ah-khatte, piak dingin na ciamsa uh a tuam vilvel citpiaknate, uttawmna hanga biaknate, na bawnghonte leh na tuuhonte’ tacilte pel loin na paipih ding uh hi.

Mikim in ama muhna ah hoih hi ci-in a gamtat bangin, tu ni-in eite hih lai mun ah i gamtat bangin na gamta nawn peuhmah kei ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh tawlngakna mun leh Yahweh na Pa un note hong piak luahna gam ah note na tung nai kei uh hi.

Ahih hangin note in Yardan kantanin Yahweh na Pa un luah dingin note hong piakna gam sungah na ten uh ciang, na kiimkota na galte khempeuh kiang panin tawlngakna hong pia-in lungmuang takin na om uh ciangin,

tua ciangin Yahweh in Ama Min a phuh nadingin a teelna mun khat om ding hi; keimah in note kong thupiak ahi na meihal biaknate leh na biakpiaknate uh, na sawm-ah-khatte, a tuam vilvel citpiaknate, Yahweh tungah na ciamsa uh a hoihpen nate khempeuh tua lai mun ah na paipih ding uh hi.
Nang leh na zi, na tapate leh na tanute, na nasem pasalte, na nasem numeite, note neih bangin tanh ahi a, luah ahi zongin a nei lo na khuasung uha om Levi mite tawh lungdam-kipaakin na om ding uh hi.
Na utna mun peuhpeuh uh ah na meihal biakna uh na piak loh na dingun kidawm un;

Ahih hangin na minamte uh sung pan minam khat panin Yahweh in a teelna mun bek ah hi ding hi. Tua lai mun ah na meihal biaknate na pia hamtang ding uh a, keimah in note kong thupiak khempeuh tua lai mun ah na hih ding uh hi.

Ahi zongin note in na khua sung peuhpeuh uh ah na ganhingte uh na go thei ding uh a, Yahweh na Pa un note hong piak thuphate tawh kizui-in sanang ahih keileh sakhi a kinek bangin a siang sate na duh bangbang un na ne thei ding uh hi.
A sisan na ne peuhmah kei bek ding uh a, tui bangin leilak ah a si na bua hamtang ding uh hi.

Na an ahi a, leenggahzu thak pan ahi a, sathau pan ahi a, bawnghonte leh tuuhonte’ tacil pan ahi a, piak dingin na ciamsa peuhpeuh uh pan ahi a, uttawmna hanga na biaknate uh pan ahi a, na khuapite sunga a tuam vilvel citpiaknate panin ahi zongin sawm-ah-khat na ne peuhmah kei ding uh hi.

Ahih hangin Yahweh na Pa un a teelna mun, Yahweh na Pa uh mai-ah hihte na ne pelmawh ding uh hi; nang leh na zi, na tapa leh na tanu, na nasem pasal, na nasem numei, leh na khuapite uh sunga om Levi mite tawh na ne ding uh hi; na sepna peuhpeuh uh ah Yahweh na Pa uh mai-ah lungdam-kipaakin na om ding uh hi.
Na gam sung uh ah na ten laitengun Levi mite awlmawh loin na om lohna dinguh kidawm un.

Yahweh na Pa un note tungah hong ciamsa bangin na gamgi uh hong khatsak ciangin note in, ‘Note in sa na duh manun nek ding sa tawmkhat beek deih sam hang ei,’ na cih uh ciangin note in sa na lunggulh zahzah uh na ne thei ding uh hi.

Yahweh na Pa un Ama Min omna dingin a teelna mun pen note kiang panin a kigamlat luat leh, keimah in note kong thupiaksa bangin Yahweh in note hong piaksa na bawnghon pan ahi a, na tuuhon pan ahi zongin na go thei ding uh a, na khuapite sung mahmah ah na duh zahzah uh na ne thei ding uh hi.
Sanang leh sakhi a kinek bangin tuate na ne thei ding uh hi; ngeina banga a sianglo mite leh ngeina banga a siang mite in ne thei ding uh hi.
Sisan pen nuntakna ahih manin sisan na nek loh ding uh theitel un, note in a sa leh a nuntakna na ne khawm peuhmah kei ding uh hi.
Note in sisan na ne peuhmah kei ding uh hi. A sisan pen tui bangin leilak ah na bua hamtang ding uh hi.
Yahweh’ muhna ah a manin na gamtat uh ciangin note leh note khita na tate uh aa dingin a hoih ahih theih nadingin note in sisan na ne peuhmah kei ding uh hi.
Note in na neih uh a siangtho nate leh kiciama biaknate bek la-in, Yahweh in a teelna mun ah pai un.

Yahweh na Pa uh biaknatau tungah a sa hitaleh a sisan hitaleh na meihal biaknate uh tua lai mun ah na pia ding uh a, Yahweh na Pa uh biaknatau tungah na biakpiakna sisan uh na sungkhia ding uh a, tua khit ciangin a sa na ne ding uh hi.

Yahweh na Pa uh muhna ah thukham tawh kituak leh a siangtho peuhmah na gamtat uh ciangin note leh note khita na tate uh aa dingin a hoih theih nadingin note kong thupiak hih thute khempeuh zui-in na mang un.
Yahweh na Pa un note mai panin minamte a beimangsak ciangin, note in amaute suankhia-in amaute gam sungah na teng ding uh a,
‘Hih minamte in amau’ pasiante’ na bangci sep uh hiam? Keimah in zong tua bangin ka hih thei ding hi,’ ci-in amau’ pasiante’ thu dotna tawh tuate’ nungzui-in na awk khak loh nadingun kidawm un.

Amaute’ ngeina bangin Yahweh na Pa uh na bia peuhmah kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in a muhdah ahi Yahweh aa dingin a kihhuai nam khempeuh, amaute in a pasiante aa dingin gamta uh hi. Amau’ pasiante biakna-in a tapate leh a tanute nangawn mei sungah hal uh hi.
Keimah in note kong thupiak peuhmah, zui-in na gamtat ding uh pilvang un; tuate na behlap kei ding uh a, tua panin zong na hemkhia kei ding uh hi.
Note lakah kamsang khat ahi a, mangmatnate tawh mailam thu a genkhol thei khat hong khangin, amah in lim leh nalamdangte bawlin,
note tungah hong gen lim leh nalamdangte hong tungin, ahih hangin amah in, ‘Pasiante nung zui nila, amaute’ na sem ni,’ hong cih uh leh,

tua kamsang ahi a mangmatnate panin mailam thu a genkholhna thute na ngai peuhmah kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh note in na lungsim khempeuh leh na nuntakna khempeuh uh tawh Yahweh na Pa uh na it uh hiam, na it kei uh hiam, cih hong theih nadingin Yahweh na Pa un hong ze-et ahi hi.

Note in pel loin a nung na zuih ding uh Yahweh na Pa uh hi a, pel loin na zahtak ding uh pen Amah ahi hi. Ama Thukhamte zui unla, Ama’ thu na mang ding uh hi; tua khit ciangin Ama na nasem ding uh a, Amah na kiplet ding uh hi.

Tua tak ciangin tua kamsang ahih keileh tua mangmatnate panin mailam thu a gen mi, pel loin kithat ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh na Pa un tot dingin hong piak lampi panin hong zolkhiat theih nading, leh salsuahna inn panin note hong tankhia leh Egypt gam panin note hong paikhiatpih Yahweh na Pa uh kiang panin na kiheikhiat theih nadingun amah langpanna thu a gen hi.

Na nu’ tapa ahi na sanggampa ahi a, na tapa ahih keileh na tanu ahi a, na angsunga na zi ahi a, na lawm itpen in ahi zongin nang hong zol simin, hong khemin, ‘Eite pai nila, pasiante va bia ni,’ hong cih leh, (tua pasiante pen na pu na pate un a theih ngei loh,
leimong khat panin adang leimong khat dong ah nang kiang panin a nai ahi a, a gamla ahi zongin note kiima om mite’ pasiante ahi hi.)
amaute zui kei inla, amaute’ thu zong mang kei un. Hehpihna zong lak kei un. Amaute suaktasak kei unla, amaute na selsim kei ding uh hi;
note in amaute pel loin na that taktak ding uh hi. Amaute a that dingin nangma khut a masa pen hisak inla, tua khit ciangin midangte khempeuh in hih ding uh hi.
Egypt gam pan, salsuahna inn panin hong paikhiatpih Yahweh na Pa uh kiang panin note hong zolin hong paikhiatpih sawm uh ahih manin a sih matengun suangtum tawh na deng ding uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin Israyl khempeuh in hih thu za-in lau ding uh a, note lakah khatbeek in zong hih banga gitlohna gamta nawn lo ding uh hi.
Yahweh in note tenna dinga hong piak khuapite uh khatpeuh ah,

note lakah gamtatsia mite hong khangin, na theih ngei loh uh pasiante thu genin, ‘Pai nila, pasiante va bia ni,’ ci-in hong zolin a lamkhial khuapi-a a teng mite in a paikhiatpihna thu a kigen na zak uh leh,
tua ciangin note in na kan ding uh a, zongin limtakin na dong ding uh hi. Tua ciangin tua thu pen a man hi-in, note lak ah tua banga a kihhuai-in gamtatna thu a om mah ahih leh,
note in namsau hiam tawh tua khuapi-a a teng mite na that taktak ding uh a, a gankhawite uh tawh a khuapi sunga om khempeuh na susia beimang ding uh hi.

Lampi laizangah tua khuapi-a a van khempeuh na kaikhawm ding uh a, Yahweh na Pa uh tungah a buppi-a meihal biakna-in a vante zong tawh a khuapi na haltum ding uh hi. Tua pen a kisiagawp khuapi hi tawntung ding a, cik mah hunin kilamkik lo ding hi.

A kimawhsak leh a kisamsia nate khatbeek na khut sung uh ah kimu lo ding hi; tua hileh Yahweh in na pu na pate uh kiangah a ciamsa bang teekteekin Amah in Ama sinsona heikhia ding a, note tungah hehpihna hong lakin, note tungah lainatna hong nei ding a, note hong pungsak ding hi;

Bang hang hiam cihleh note in Yahweh na Pa uh thu mangin, Yahweh na Pa uh muhna ah a man leh Thukham tawh a kituak bangin gamtat nadingin tu ni-in keimah in note kong thupiak Ama Thukhamte khempeuh na zui hang uh hi.
Note pen Yahweh na Pa uh tate na hi uh hi. Misi hangin nomau’ mah ki-atkeh tawm loin, na sam uh zong na mettol vet kei ding uh hi;

Bang hang hiam cihleh note pen Yahweh na Pa uh tungah a siangtho mite na hi uh hi. Yahweh in Ama aa dingin note hong teelkhin a, leitung maitang-a om mi khempeuh sangin a tuam vilvel a manpha-in hong teelzaw hi.
Note in a kihhuai na khat peuhpeuh na ne peuhmah kei ding uh hi;
Hihte pen na nek theih ding uh ganhingte ahi hi: bawng, tuu, keel,
sakhital, sanang, simsakhi, sathak, saza, gamkeel, leh gamtuu ahi hi.
A khecin ka-in, eknel zong a hai ganhing peuhmah na ne thei ding uh hi.

Ahi zongin eknel a hai lak panin ahih keileh a khecin a ka ganhing lak panin na nek loh dingte uh pen: kalaoh, bilpi, leh sakikh ahi hi. Tuate in eknel a hai hangin, a khecin ka lo ahih manin, note aa dingin a siang lo ahi hi.
Vok pen note aa dingin a siang lo ahi hi; vok pen a khecin a kat hangin, eknel hai lo hi. Note in tuate’ sa na ne peuhmah kei ding uh a, a sisa zong na lawng kei ding uh hi.
Hihte pen tuite sunga om na nek theih dingte uh ahi hi: phe leh lip a nih tuakin a nei khempeuh na ne thei ding uh hi.
Phe leh lip a nei lo peuhmah na ne vet kei ding uh hi. Tua pen note aa dingin a siang lo ahi hi.
A siang vasate khempeuh na ne thei ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin hihte pen na ne kei ding uh hi: muvanlai, musane, luimu,
mupi, mumeika, leh mupi nam peuhpeuh,
va-ak nam peuhpeuh,
vasa-kalaoh, pengpelep, vatawt, musi nam peuhpeuh,
keising, simbu, simbu kang,
gam-simbu, samuat ne musane, tuimu,
gun va-kheng-sang, gun vazonei nam khempeuh, huihtun leh bak ahi hi.
A hontatin kha a nei ganhing neu ciauciaute khempeuh, note aa dingin a siang lo ahi hi; tuate ne kei un.
Ahi zongin kha a nei ganhing a siang peuhpeuh na ne thei ding uh hi.

A sisa-a na muh ganhing peuhmah ne kei un. Na khua sung uha om gamdang mi tungah na pia thei ding uh a, amah in ne thei ding hi; tua bang ahih keileh khualmi khatpeuh tungah na zuak thei ding uh hi. Ahih hangin note pen Yahweh na Pa uh tungah a siangtho mite na hi uh hi. Tuuno pen a pi nawizu tawh na huan khawm peuhmah kei ding uh hi.
Na ngahna uh panin sawm-ah-khat mantakin na pia ding uh hi—a kumkumin na ngah uh an, hong kipia sum, ganhingte pan ahi hi.

Yahweh na Pa uh a tawntungin na zahtak theih nadingun, na an uh pan, leenggahzu thak pan, na sathau uh pan, na bawnghonte leh na tuuhonte tacilte panin A Nih veina sawm-ah-khat, Yahweh na Pa uh mai, Ama Min a phuh nadingin a teelna mun ah ne un.

Ahi zongin note aa dingin a lampi sau lua-in tuate na puak zawh kei uh a, ahih keileh Yahweh na Pa un Ama Min koih na dingin a teelna mun pen note kiang panin a lamnat luat leh, Yahweh na Pa un note thupha hong piak ciangin,
tuate sum na suah ding uh a, na khut sungah tua sumte tawi-in Yahweh na Pa un a teelna mun ah na paipih ding uh hi.

Tua tak ciangin na lunggulh peuhpeuh uh bawng ahi a, tuu ahi a, leenggahzu ahi a, zu khauh ahi a, na duh peuhpeuh uh leina-in tua sum na zeek ding uh hi. Tua khit ciangin note in Yahweh na Pa un mai, tua lai mun ah na ne ding uh a, note leh na innkuanpihte lungdam-kipaakin na om ding uh hi.
Na khuapite sunga om Levi mite thusim loin na om kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in note tawh sehtanh ahi a, luah ahi zongin nei lo uh hi.
Kum thum sim, kum bei kuan ciangin, a kisehsa tua kuma na ngah uh A Thum veina seh-sawm-suah-seh-khat khempeuh na paipih ding uh a, na khuasungte uh ah na khol ding uh hi.

Tua hileh na khuasung uha om, note tawh sehtanh ahi a, luah ahi zongin ngah lo uh ahih manin A Masa seh-sawm-suah-seh-khat a ngah Levi mite, peemtate, pa nei nawn lote, meigongte, Yahweh’ Pawite ah pai-in ne thei ding uh a, lungkim ding uh hi; tua ahih manin Yahweh na Pa un na khutte uh’ sepna khempeuh ah note thupha hong pia ding hi.
A kum sagihna a bei ciangin a kibate na maisak ding uh hi.

Hih pen a kimaisak nading zia ahi hi: A sanggampa tungah leitawi a pia mi peuhmah in a piaksate maisak ding hi. Yahweh’ maisakna thu kigenkhin ahih manin amah in a sanggampa’ tung pan a leiba siik nawn lo ding hi.
Gamdang mi kiang panin note in hong leibat na siik ding uh a, ahih hangin na sanggampa in hong bat pen na maisak ding hi.

Ahih hangin note lakah mizawngte leh a cimawh mite om lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh na Pa un luah-in na neih nadingun note hong piakna gam sungah Yahweh in note nakpitakin thupha hong pia ding hi—
Yahweh na Pa uh thu’ na man taktak uh a, tu ni-in keimah in note kong thupiak hih Thukhamte khempeuh hoih takin zui-in na gamtat uh leh, note lakah mizawng leh mi cimawh om lo ding hi;

Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in note hong ciamsa bang teekteekin Yahweh na Pa un note thupha hong pia ding hi. Yahweh in note hong piakna gam sunga khuapite khatpeuh sungah a teng a zawng na sanggam khatpeuh a om leh, na lungsim uh khauhsak loin, na sanggam a zawng pa huh loin na om peuhmah kei ding uh hi.
Ama tungah na cingh gamtat ding uh a, ama kisap na peuhpeuh a kicingin phal takin na leitawi hamtang ding hi.

‘A kum sagihna kum, leiba maisak kum hong nai luata hi,’ ci-in hih bang ngaihsutna hoih lo na ngaihsut loh na ding un kidawm un; tua tak ciangin note in a cihmawh na sanggampa uh tungah lainatna nei loin, bangmah na pia kei uh hi. Ama tungah pel loin na pia taktak ding uh a, iplah bawlin na pia kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh a taktakin Yahweh tungah leiba a pia na hi uh hi; Yahweh na Pa un na nasepte khempeuh leh a sem dingin na khut na ngakna khempeuh uh ah thupha hong pia ding hi.
Ahih hangin na gam sung panun mizawng bei ngei lo ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin note kong thupiak inah: na gam sunga a zawngte leh a cimawh na sanggamte uh tungah na cingh mahmah ding uh hi.

Na sanggampa, Hebrew pasal khat ahi a, Hebrew numei khat ahi zongin nangma tungah amahmah hong kizuakin ahih keileh nang tungah khatpeuh in hong zuak leh, nangma’ na kum guk sung sem ding a, a kum sagihna ciangin nangma kiang panin suakta takin na paisak pelmawh ding hi.
Nang kiang panin amah a kikhahkhiat ciangin khut hawmguak tawh na paisak peuhmah kei ding a,
na tuuhon lak pan, na ancilna pan, na leenggah sukna panin cingh takin na guan hamtang ding hi. Yahweh in note hong piak thupha peuhpeuh tawh note in ama tungah na piak ding uh ahi hi.
Egypt gam sungah sila na hihna uh leh Yahweh in note hong tatkhiatna na phawk hamtang ding uh hi; tua hangin tu ni-in hih thu hong pia ka hi hi.
Ahih hangin amah in nang leh na innkuanpihte hong itin note nuam hongsa ahih manin, amah in nangma kiangah, ‘note hong taisan nuam kei ing,’ a cih leh,
tua ciangin nangmah in phimpi khat na la ding a, kongkhak dapphahin a bil na vut ding a, amah pen a nuntak sung tawntung na nasem hi ding hi. Na nasem numei tungah zong tua mah bangin na hih ding hi.

Nang kiang panin a suakta-in amah na koih ciangin, haksa sa peuhmah kei in; bang hang hiam cihleh a kicial nasempa sep thaman zahnih hih kum guk sung hong ngahsakkhin hi. Tua ciangin Yahweh na Pa in na sepna khempeuh ah thupha hong pia ding hi.

Na bawnghon leh na tuuhon panin a piang tacil apa khempeuh, note in na siansuah ding uh a, Yahweh aa dingin na tuamkoih ding uh hi. Na bawnghon tacil tawh na nasem peuhmah kei ding uh a, na tuuhon tacilte zong a mul na met peuhmah kei ding hi.
Note leh Levi innkuan in Yahweh in a teelna mun, Yahweh na Pa uh mai-ah kum khat khit kum khat ganhing tacilte tawh biakpiaknate panin a sa na ne ding uh hi.
Tua ganhingte lakah poina khatpeuh, a khebai, a mittaw, ahih keileh adang poina khatpeuh a neih leh, Yahweh na Pa uh tungah biakpiakna-in na pia peuhmah kei ding uh hi.
Na khuapite uh sungah sanang leh sakhi na nek bangun na ne ding uh a, ngeina bangin a siang lote leh ngeina bangin a siang mite in ne thei ding uh hi.
A sisan tawh na nekhawm kei bek ding uh hi; tui bangin leilak ah a sisan na bua ding uh hi.

Mangbuh-ham a Vuih thak Kha; Abib kha, encik unla, Yahweh na Pa uh tungah Paisan biakpiakna pia un; bang hang hiam cihleh Buhkungte a Nosuah Kha sungin Yahweh na Pa un Egypt gam panin zanin note hong paikhiatpih hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in Ama Min a phuh nadingin a teelna mun, Yahweh na Pa uh tungah tuuhon leh bawnghon panin pel loin Paisan biakpiakna na pia ding uh hi.

Tua tawh silngo kisawh anlum na ne khawm peuhmah kei ding uh a, ni sagih sung silngo sawh loh anlum na ne ding uh hi; (Nawhsa takin Egypt gam panin paikhiat na hih manun) gimna anlum tawh na ne ding uh hi; tua hileh Egypt gam panin na taikhiat ni uh na nuntak sung tawntung na phawk thei ding uh hi.
Na gam sung khempeuh uh ah ni sagih sung note lakah silngo kimu lo ding a, a nitakin biakpiakna-in na piak uh sa khat peuhpeuh zong a zingsang dong zan tawntung na omsak kei ding uh hi.
Yahweh in note hong piak na khuapite uh khat peuhpeuh sungah Paisan biakna na pia thei ding uh a,
ahih hangin Yahweh na Pa un Ama Min phuh nadingin a teelna mun bek ah hi ding hi. Egypt gam panin na paikhiat hun, nitak lam ni a tan lai-in Paisan biakna na pia hamtang ding uh hi.
Note in a sa em-in, Yahweh na Pa un a teelna mun ah na ne ding uh a, zingsang ciangin note kihei-in na puanbukte uh ah na ciah ding uh hi.
Ni guk sung note in silngo sawh loh anlum na ne hamtang ding uh a, a ni sagih ni-in Yahweh na Pa uh tungah a siangtho kikhopna khat om ding hi. Note in na nasem peuhmah kei ding uh hi.
Nomau’ mahin kaal sagih na sim ding uh hi. Buhkung dingte phiaukawi tawh at ding na kipat hun uha kipanin kaal sagih sim ding kipan un.
Tua khit ciangin note in Yahweh na Pa un note thupha hong piakna tawh kizui-in na khutsung panin uttawmna hanga biakna sehtanh tawh Yahweh tungah Nipi Kaal Pawi na bawl ding uh hi.

Yahweh in Ama Min phuh nadingin a teelna mun, Yahweh na Pa uh mai-ah nang leh na zi, na tapa, na tanu, na nasem pasal, na nasem numei, na khua sunga a teng Levi mite, peemtate, pa nei nawn lote, note laka om meigongte, lungdam-kipaakin na om ding uh hi.
Egypt gam sungah sila na hihna uh pel loin na phawk ding uh a, hih ngeina kipte zui-in na sep ding uh pilvang gige un.
Na ancilna leh na leenggah sukna panun an na kaihkhopkhit uh ciangin note in ni sagih sung Buk Pawi na bawl hamtang ding uh hi;
nang-a kipan na zi, na tapa, na tanu, na nasem pasal, na nasem numei, Levi mite, peemtate, pa nei nawn lote, leh na khuapite sunga meigongte, tua Pawi sungah lungdam-kipaakin om ding uh hi;

Yahweh in a teel nading ah ni sagih sung Yahweh na Pa uh tungah a lungnophuai Pawi na bawl pelmawh ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh na ngahna khempeuh uh leh na khut tawh na sepna khempeuh uh ah Yahweh na Pa un thupha hong pia ding hi; tua ahih manin note in lungnopna na ngah taktak ding uh hi.

Yahweh in a teelna mun ah, pasal khempeuh Yahweh mai-ah kum khatin thum vei kilaak ding hi— Silngo Sawh loh Anlum Pawi, Nipi kaal Pawi leh Buk Pawi ah hi ding hi—amaute khut hawmguakin kilaak peuhmah lo ding uh hi;
Yahweh na Pa un note hong piak thupha tawh kituakin, mi khempeuh in ama hih theih bang ciatin pia ding uh hi.
Na minam ciat uh panin Yahweh na Pa in note hong piakna khuapite ah thukhente leh uliante na seh pelmawh ding uh a, amaute in a thuman thukhenna tawh mite’ thu khen ding uh hi.

Thutang na heikhia vet kei ding uh hi. Note in angvan tuam na nei kei ding uh a, golhguk zong na la kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh golhguk in mipilte’ mitte tawsakin, thuman mite’ thu kikai-awksak hi.
Thutang na zui ding uh hi, thutang bek hi ding hi; tua hileh note nungta-in Yahweh na Pa un note hong piak gam na luah ding uh hi.
Yahweh na Pa uh aa dingin na bawl ding uh biaknatau lobuang, a thupit ngaihsut uh khuampi; Asherah khuampi-a kizang dingin singkung na suan peuhmah kei ding uh a,
a thupit ngaihsut uh leikhuampi; ni-pasian Baal milim, zong na phut peuhmah kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh hihte pen Yahweh na Pa un mudah hi.
Poina hemna khatpeuh a nei bawngtal ahi a, tuutal ahi zongin Yahweh na Pa uh tungah biakna-in pia kei un; bang hang hiam cihleh tua pen Yahweh na Pa uh tungah a kihhuai ahi hi.
Yahweh na Pa un note hong piak khua khat peuhpeuh sungah pasal ahi a, numei ahi zongin Yahweh’ thuciam palsatna tawh Ama muhna ah a sia a gamta note lakah kimu-in,
note in na hih loh dingun keimah in kong gensa ahi pasiante lamah pai-in bia-in a na semin, tuate mai-ah kunin, ahih keileh, ni, kha leh vantunga aksite bia-in,
hih thu note zakna ah hong kipuak leh, note in hih thu limtakin na kantel ding uh hi. Tua thu a man hi a, Israyl sungah hih banga a kihhuaina a kigamta a hi taktak ahih leh,
tua numei ahi a, pasal ahi zongin a sia-in a gamta mi pen na khuapi kulhkongpi ah paipihin, suang tawh tua mi na denglum ding uh hi.
Tecipanna nih ahih keileh tecipang thum tungah kinga-in mipa kithat bek ding a, ahih hangin khat guak bek i tecipanna tungah kinga-in that ding hi lo hi.
Tecipangte’ khut mahmah pen a that dingin a masa pen hi hamtang ding a, tua khit ciangin midangte hi pan ding hi. Hih bang danin note laka a siatna na beisiangsak ding uh hi.
Sisan kisuahna ahi a, thu kineihna ahi, ahih keileh khut khialhna ahi zongin thu khen dingin note aa dingin a haksalua thu a om leh, Yahweh na Pa un a teelna munah amaute na paipih ding uh hi.
Levi mite ahi siampite leh tua huna zum sunga om thukhente kiangah na pai ding uh hi. Amaute’ khensatna na dong ding uh a, amaute in thukhenna hong pia ding hi.
Yahweh in a teelna mun ah note aa dingin amaute’ hong genkhiat dantatna tawh kizui-in na hih pelmawh ding uh hi. Note hih dingin amau’ hong thupiak khempeuh hoih takin na hih ding uh phawk un.

Amaute’ hong hilh thukham tawh kizui-in na hih ding uh a, amaute hong piak khensatnate tawh kizui-in na hih ding uh hi. Note aa dingin amau genkhiat dantatna panin taklam ahi a, veilam ahi zongin na pialkhia peuhmah kei ding uh hi.
Yahweh na Pa uh mai-ah biaknasep a sem dingin a ding siampipa ahih keileh thukhenpa zahpih bawlin a uangtat mipa kithat ding hi. Hih bang danin Israyl sung panin siatna na beisiangsak ding uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin mi khempeuh in tua thu za-in lau ding uh a, kuamah in cikmahin zahpih bawl nawn lo ding uh hi.
Yahweh na Pa un note hong piakna gam ah na lutin tua gam luahin a sungah na ten uh ciangin, note in, ‘Eite kiima minamte khempeuh bangin eite tungah kumpi khat koih ni,’ na ci ding uh hi.

Tua tak ciangin Yahweh na Pa un a teel mi bek note tungah kumpi dingin na koih ding uh theitel un. Amah pen na sanggamte lak pan bek uh hi hamtang ding hi. Amah pen na sanggam uh ahi lo gamdangmi hi peuhmah lo ding hi.

Amah in ama aituam dingin sakol tampi nei lo ding a, sakol tampi a ngah nadingin Egypt gam ah mite paisak peuhmah lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in, ‘Tua lampi ah note na paikik peuhmah kei ding uh hi,’ hong cikhin hi.
Amah pen a zi uksa-a om hi peuhmah lo ding a, ngun leh kham i uksa zong hi peuhmah lo ding hi; tua bang hi keileh ama lungtang; a thutheihna, kihei khial ding hi.
Ama kumpi gam, kumpi tokhom tungah amah a tut ciangin, (Levi mi ahi siampite kiang panin kawmin) ama aa dingin laizial tungah hih Thukham mah gelh ding hi.
Tua pen ama in kemsuak ding a, a nuntak sung tawntungin sim ding hi; tua hileh hih Thukham leh ngeina kipte-a thute khempeuh limtakin zuihna tawh Yahweh a Pa zahtak dan ding amah in thei ding hi.

Tua ahih ciangin amah pen kihisak loin a sanggamte sangin a thupizaw-in kingaihsun kha lo ding a, hih Thukham panin taklam ahi a, veilam ahi zongin pial lo ding hi. Tua tak ciangin amah leh ama suanlekhakte in kumpi gam laizangah sau veipi uk ding uh hi.

Siampite ahi Levi minam buppi in Israyl-te tawh sehtanh ahi a, luah ahi zongin nei lo ding uh hi. Amaute in Yahweh tunga mei tawh kihal biaknate tawh nungta ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tua pen amaute’ sehtanh ahi hi.
Amaute in a sanggamte lakah luah nei lo ding uh hi. Yahweh in amaute tungah a gensa mah bangin Amah pen amaute’ luah ahi hi.
Hih pen bawngtal ahi a, tuu ahi zongin a go mipa kiang panin siampipa’ tanh ahi hi: a liang, a paang tenih, leh a sungkuate ahi hi.
Na an, leenggahzu thak, sathau-te panin a palte leh na tuu panin na meet masak uh tuumul, amaute na piak ding uh ahi hi;
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh Min tawh biaknasep a sem tawntung dingin Yahweh na Pa un na minamte khempeuh uh panin amah leh a tapate teelkhinzo hi.
Israyl-te sunga ama tenna ahi na khuapite uh khatpeuh panin Levi mi khat hong paikhia-in, Yahweh’ in a teelna mun ah lunglawp takin hong pai leh,
Yahweh’ mai-a nasep Levi mi a sanggam a kithuahpihte khempeuh mah bangin Yahweh a Pa Min tawh na sem thei ding hi.
Amah in innkuan neihsate a zuakna pan sum ngahkhin himah leh a tunna-a siampite’ hamphatnate ah kikim takin tanh a ngah lai ding hi.
Yahweh na Pa un note hong piakna gam sungah na tun uh ciangin, tua minamte’ a kihhuai gamtatziate zuih dingin na kisin kei ding uh hi.
Note lakah a tanu ahi a, a tapa ahi zongin mei sungah biakpiakna-in a pia, ai a saan, thumuh kholhna a neite, mailam thu a gen, ai a tawi,
bum a zang, kha tawh kizawlin a kihote, sikhate tawh a kiho, sikha thu a dong kuamah na omsak kei ding uh hi.
Hihte a hih mi peuhmah, Yahweh tungah a kihhuai ahi hi; bang hang hiam cihleh hih a kihhuai gamtatnate hangin Yahweh na Pa un note mai-a minamte a hawlkhiat ahi hi.
Yahweh na Pa uh mai-ah a kicing paubaanna nei loin na om hamtang ding uh hi.

Note in a hawlkhiat ding uh hih minamte in thumuh kholh theina a neite, mai lam thu genkholhte’ thu ngai uh hi. Ahih hangin note na hih uh leh Yahweh na Pa un tua nate a sem dingin hong seh peuhmah lo hi.
Yahweh na Pa un na sanggamte sung mahmah panin note aa dingin keimah bangin Kamsang khat hong khangsak ding hi. Note in Ama thu na ngai hamtang ding uh hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh hih pen note na kikaikhop ni-in Horeb ah Yahweh na Pa uh tungah na cih uh ahi hi: note in, ‘Yahweh kote Pa’ awging hong zasak nawn kei inla, hih a lian meikuang zong hong musak nawn kei in; tua bang hi keileh ka si ding uh hi,’ na ci uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahweh in keima kiangah, ‘Amaute in a gen uh thu pen a man ahi hi.
A sanggamte lak panin amaute aa dingin nang tawh a kibang Kamsang khat khangsak ding a, Ama kam sungah Ka kammalte ka koih ding a, Keimah in Amah thu ka piak khempeuh amaute tungah gen ding hi.
Amah in Keima Min tawh a gen Ka kammalte a don lo mi peuhmah, tua thu hangin Keimah in tua mi tungah thu ka khen ding hi.

Ahih hangin Keimah in a gen dingin thupia lo na pi-in gelkholsa, ama thu bek thusa-in thei pipi-in Ka Min tawh thu a gen kamsangpa hitaleh pasian khatpeuh min tawh thu a gen pa hitaleh, tua kamsangpa pel loin kithat ding hi.
Note in na lungsim sung uh ah: ‘Yahweh in a gen thu ahi lo bangci bangin thei ding i hi hiam?’ na ci kha ding uh hi.

Yahweh Min tawh kamsangpa’ thu gen pen hong tangtung loin, a man lopi ahih leh, tua thu pen Yahweh in a gen loh thu ahi hi. Tua kamsangpa in gelkholsa, ama thu bek thusa-in thei pipi-in a man lo thu a gen hi a, amah zahtak kei un.
Yahweh na Pa un note hong piakna gam-a minamte Yahweh a Pa un a susia-in, amaute hawlkhia-in, amau’ khuapite ah tengin, amau’ innte sungah na om uh ciangin,
Yahweh na Pa un luah dingin note hong piakna gam sungah note aa dingin gam laizang deuh ah a om khuapi thum na tuamkoih ding uh hi.
A lampite na puah ding uh a, Yahweh na Pa un luah dingin note hong piakna gam khen thum na suah ding uh hi; tua hileh mi a that kha peuhpeuh tua lai mun ah tai thei ding uh hi.
Hihte pen tua lai mun ah a tai khit ciangin a nungta thei ding mipa aa dingin khensatna a piangsakte ahi hi: Mipa pen ngim kholhna tawh hi loin, sawm lopi-in a vengpa a that kha khat ahi ding hi.

Gentehna-in: Mi khat sing phuk dingin a sanggampa tawh singlak ah pai-in, amah in a singkung a phuk dingin a hei a vik ciangin a heitang lengkhia-in a sanggampa sukha-in a sih leh, tua mipa pen hih khuapite khat sungah tai thei ding a, amah nungta ding hi.
Tua bang hi loin sihna ding thu omlo na pi, a beisa hunin a sanggampa muhdahna zong omlo na pi-in, sisan-phulapa in hehluatna hangin amah delhin lampi gamla lua ahih manin a pha-in that kha ding hi.
Tua thu hangin note aa dingin khuapi thum na tuamkoih nadingun thu hong pia ka hi hi.
Yahweh na Pa un na pu na pate uh tungah kiciamna tawh a ciamsa bangin note gamgi hong khatsakin Amah in amaute tunga a ciam gam buppi note hong pia-in,

Yahweh na Pa uh it theih nading uh leh, Ama lampi na zuih theih nadingun tu ni-a note kong thupiak hih thukhamte khempeuh na zuih uh leh, hih khuapi thumte banah note aa dingin khuapi thum na behlap lai ding uh a,
tua hi keileh Yahweh na Pa un luah dingin note hong piakna na gam sung uh ah mawhbaang lo mi kithat kha ding a, tua mi thahna hanga mawhna note tungah hong tu ding hi.
Ahi zongin mi khat in a sanggampa mudahin, amah pangsimin, amah satin thatlumin, tua mipa hih khuapite khat peuhpeuh ah a tai leh,
ama hong paikhiatna khua sung upate in mi sawlin, kibukna khuapi panin amah paikhiatkik ding uh a, a sih theih nadingin sisan-phulapa tungah ap ding uh hi.
Note in ama tungah na hehpih peuhmah kei ding uh hi. Note aa dingin a hoih ahih theih nadingin Israyl sung panin mawhbaang mi kithatna na beisiangsak hamtang ding uh hi.
Yahweh na Pa un note hong piakna gam sungah na luah ding uh ahi na gamhluahna sung uha khanglui mite phuhsa huang ciaptehna ahi na sanggampa’ gisuang na hemkhia peuhmah kei ding uh hi.

Mi khat in a hihkhak mawhna lian ahi a, khialhna khat peuhpeuh a gamtatna-ah ahi zongin tua mipa’ langah teci khat guak kicing lo ding hi. Teci nih ahih keileh teci thum bang thugenna tawh mawhsakna kikipsak bek ding hi.
Gamtat khialhna khatpeuh a mawhsak dingin mi khatpeuh langah a man lo teci pang a om leh,
thuneihna sungah a kihel a lang nih tuakun Yahweh’ mai, siampite leh tua hun lai-a thukhen a sem mite mai-ah ding pelmawh ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin thukhente in limtakin kantel ding uh a, a sanggampa langah a man lo teci panna tawh a man lo teci ahih lam ahih theih leh,
a sanggampa tungah hih dinga a sawm bang teekteekin ama tungah na hih ding uh hi. Hih bang danin note lak panin siatna na beisiangsak ding uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin a omlai mite in hih thu za-in lau ding uh a, note lakah tua bang gitlohna cikmahin kigamta nawn lo ding hi.
Note in na hehpih peuhmah kei ding uh hi: nuntakna tang ding nuntakna, mittang tang ding mitang, hatang tang ding hatang, khut tang ding khut, khe tang ding khe kihihkik ding uh hi.

Na galte uh do dingin pai-in a sakolte, a leengte, leh a mite note sangin a tamzawkna na muh uh ciangin, kihta kei un; bang hang hiam cihleh Egypt gam pana note hong paikhitpih Yahweh na Pa uh note tawh hong om hi.
Gal na do kuan uh ciangin, siampipa a mai-ah hong pai-in gal do ding mite kiangah thugenna nei-in,
amah in amaute kiangah, ‘Israyl-te aw, za un: Tuni-in na galte uh langah a do ding na hita uh hi. Meidawi kei un, kihta kei un, amaute hangin ling kei un, lau kei un;
Bang hang hiam cihleh note aa dingin na galte uh a do dingin note tawh a paipa, note gualzawhna hong piapa pen Yahweh na Pa uh ahi hi,’ ci ding hi.

Tua khit ciangin uliante in gal kuan ding mite kiangah thu genin, ‘Inn thak lam khinin a ap nai lo kua om na hi uh hiam? Gal sungah amah si-in midang khat in a inn ap kha ding ahih manin a inn ah ciahkik hen.
Leenggui lo kho khinin a gah a ne nai lo kua om na hi uh hiam? Gal sungah amah si-in midang khat in tuate na ne kha ding hi.
Numei khat kiangah tenpih dingin kikham khinin a tenpih nai lo kua om na hi uh hiam? Gal sungah amah si-in midang khat in tua nu tenpih kha ding ahih manin a inn ah ciahkik hen,’ ci ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin uliante in thu gen thuah lai-in, ‘A lau khatpeuh, a meidawi khatpeuh a om hiam? A inn ah ciahkik sak un, tua hileh a sanggamte zong meidawi sakkha lo ding uh hi,’ ci ding uh hi.
Gal kuan ding mite kiangah uliante in a thugen uh a mankhit ciangin, mite a makaih dingin galkapte tungah makaite seh ding uh hi.
A do dingin khuapi khatpeuh na naih uh ciangin tua khua-a mite kiangah kilem nading thu gen masa un.
Amaute in kilem nading na genna uh hong sang thei-in, amau’ kulhkongpite hong hon leh, tua sunga om mi khempeuh in note aa dingin aana tawh na semin, na na uh hong sepsak ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin note tawh kilemna hong bawl loin note hong do leh, note in tua khua na umcih ding uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yahweh na Pa un note khut sungah hong piak ciangin, tua sunga om pasal khempeuh namsau hiam tawh na that ding uh hi.

Ahih hangin numei, naupang, ganhingte leh tua khua sunga om na khempeuh note aa dingin na la ding uh a, note aa dingin na zang ding uh hi; Yahweh na Pa un note hong piak ding na galte uh vante na tang ding uh hi.
Hih nai-a om minamte’ khuapite ahi lo, notekiang panin a gamla khuapi khempeuh tungah tu-a bangin na hih ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh na Pa un luah dingin note hong piak minamte’ khuapite sungah om husang khempeuh na hingkhawi kei ding uh hi.
Yahweh na Pa un note thu hong piaksa bangin note in Hit mite, Amor mite, Canaan mite, Perez mite leh Yebus mite, a vekpi-in na susia maimang ding uh hi;
Tua bang ahih keileh amaute in a pasiante uh tunga a gamtat uh a kihhuainate khempeuh note hong hilh ding uh a, Yahweh na Pa uh tungah note na mawh ding uh hi.

Khuapi khat na lak theih nadingun do-in sauveipi na umcih uh ciangin a singkungte phukna tawh singkungte na susia kei ding uh hi. A gahte a kine thei ahih leh, khuapi umcihna-in zat dingin tua singkungte phuk kei un; bang hang hiam cihleh tuate pen anin na mang thei ding uh hi.
Gah a nei lo singkung hi, ci-in na theihte bek na susia thei ding uh a, note do khuapi a tuk matengin tua khuapi umcihna-in na zat dingun phuk kei un.
Yahweh na Pa un luah dingin note hong piakna gam sung lolak khatpeuh ah mi khat kithatin lum a, a that a kitheih kei leh,
na upate leh na thukhente pai ding uh a, misiluang omna panin a kiima khuapite a gamlatna teh ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin misiluang tawh a kinai pen khua-a upate in a kisin nai lo, kol a kai nai lo bawngla khat la ding uh hi;
a kikho nai lo, khaici a kivawh nai lo, tuiluang a omna kuam khat ah a bawngla paipih ding uh hi. Tua lai mun, tua kuam sungah a bawngla’ ngawng attan ding uh hi.

Levi’ suante ahi siampite a nai-ah hong pai ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh na Pa un biaknasep a sem ding leh Yahweh Min tawh thuphate a tangko ding leh, kinialna leh khutkhialhna tawh kisai thukineihna khempeuh a khensat dingin amaute teelkhin hi.
Tua ciangin misiluang tawh a kinai pen khua-a upate in kuam sunga a ngawn a ki-attan tua bawngla tungah a khutte uh sil ding uh a,
amaute in teci pangin, ‘Kote khutte in hih sisan ka suah kei uh a, sisan a kisuah lai-in zong ka mu kei uh hi.

Yahweh aw, na hotkhiatsa Na mi Israyl-te mawhna hong maisak nadingin hih mawhkhuhna hong sang inla, mawhna nei lo mipa a kithahna hanga mawhna Na mite hong thuaksak kei in. Mi thahna hanga mawhna pan hong maisak in,’ ci ding uh hi.
Yahweh’ muhna ah a manin na gamtat uh ciangin, note lak panin mawh nei lote sisan kiluansakna hih bang danin na beisiangsak ding uh hi.
Na galte uh a do dingin kuan khia-in, Yahwen in note khut sungah amaute hong pia-in, na galmatte uh na lak uh ciangin,
galmatte lak panin numei melhoih khatpeuh mu-in, tua nu na deih uh leh, na zi dingin na la thei ding hi.
Na inn sungah tua nu na paipih ding a, a sam mettolin, a cinte tanin,

a kimat lai-a a silh puante na tuamkoih ding uh hi. Na inn sungah amah a om khit ciangin, a nu leh a pa’ hangin kha khat bit sung kap ding a, tua khit ciangin amah na luppihin a pasal na hi ding a, amah pen na zi hi ding hi.

Ahih hangin amah na deih nawn kei leh, ama utna peuh ah na paisak ding hi; ahih hangin amah pen sum tawh na zuak kei taktak ding a, sila bangin zong na bawl kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah na mindaisak khin hi.
Pasal khat in zi nih nei-in, khat itzaw-in, adang khat it lozaw-in, amau tenih tapa nei tuakin, a it lohzawk a zi’ tapa pen a tacil ahih leh,
a tapate tungah gamhluah dingin ama neihsa a hawm ciangin, a it lohzawk a zi tawh a tapa ahi ama tacil taktak pa tangin, a itzawk a zi tawh a tacil tungah tacil hihna hamphatnate pia thei lo ding hi.
Ama neih khempeuh panin sehtanh nih piakna tawh a it lohzawk a zi tawh a tapa a tacil mahin sang ding hi. Tua tapa pen a pa’ thahatna lim masa ahi hi. Tacil hamphatnate ama aa ahi hi.
Mi khat in a lungkhauh, a langpang hei, a nu’ thu ahi a, a pa’ thu ahi zongin a mang lo, a thuhilh khit ciang nangawnin a mau’ thu a ngai lo tapa khat a neih leh,
a nu leh a pa in amah manin ama khuapi upate kiang, a tenna mun kongpi-ah paipihin,
a khuapi upate kiangah amaute in, ‘Hih ka tapa uh lungkhauh-in a langpang thei ahi hi. Amah in kote thu hong mang lo ding hi. Amah pen a ngongtat gawp leh a zuhai bek ahi hi,’ ci ding uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin a khuapi-a mite khempeuh in suangtum tawh denglum ding uh hi. Hih bang danin note lak panin migilote na beisiangsak ding uh hi. Israyl khempeuh in hih thu za-in lau ding uh hi.
Mi khat in sihna thuak theih nading mawhna bawlin amah kithat a, ama luang sing tungah a kikhai leh,

A misiluang pen zan tawntung sing tungah omsuak lo ding hi. Yahweh na Pa un luah dingin note hong piakna gam a ninsak na suah loh nadingun note in tua ni mahin pel loin na phum pah ding uh hi. A kihai mipa pen Yahweh’ samsiat mi ahi hi.
Na mipihte’ bawngtal ahi a, a tuu ahi zongin a gammang na muh uhleh awlmawh loin na om kei ding uh hi. Na mipihpa kiangah na ciahpihkik ding uh hi.
Na mipihpa pen nang tawh kinai-a teng ahih kei a, amah kua ahi hiam ci-in na theih keileh, na inn uh ah a gan ciahpihin hong kikan mateng na kem ding uh hi.
Tua bangin a laa, a puan, ahih keileh na mipihpa in a mansuah khat peuhpeuh na muh leh hih bang mahin na hih ding uh hi. Awlmawh loin na om peuhmah kei ding uh hi.
Na mipihte’ laa ahi a, a bawngtal ahi zongin lam gei-ah a kia na muh leh awlmawh loin om kei in. A pai theihna dingin na huh ding hi.
Numei in pasal tawh a kisai himhim silh peuhmah lo ding a, pasal in numei puan silh peuhmah lo ding hi. Tua bangin a hih peuhmah Yahweh na Pa uh tungah a kihhuai ahi hi.
Lam gei ah vasa bu khat, singkung tung ahi a, leilak ah ahi zongin a om, a pi in a no a ompih ahi a, a op lai ahi zongin na muh leh, a pi pen a no tawh lakhawm kei un.
Note ading a hoih ahih nading leh saupi na nuntak theih nadingun a pi na khah ding uh a, a no na la thei ding uh hi.
Na inn tung panun mi khat kia-in mi sihna hanga mawhna na innsung uh ah na tunsak khak loh nadingun inn thak na lam uh ciangin, na innkhumzang uh ah tangban na khung ding uh hi.
Na leenggui lo uh ah khaici nam nih na vawh kei ding uh hi. Vawh le-uh cin na vawh uh an bek hi loin na leenggui lo uh ah a piang khempeuh zong a nin suak ding hi.
Bawngtal khat leh laa khat tawh lo na kho khawm peuhmah kei ding uh hi.
Samul puan leh khau a kigan khawm puan na silh vet kei ding uh hi.
Na kitunna uh dialpi; tallit, kiu lite tungah puanmongteep na bawl hamtang ding uh hi.
Pasal khat in zi la-in, a luppih khit ciangin, amah in deih loin,
tua nu mawhsakin, ‘Keimah in hih numei ka la a, amah tawh ka lupkhop ciangin, ama sungah nungakna lim ka mu kei hi,’ cihna tawh tua nu tungah minsia a tut leh,
tua numei’ nu leh pa in a tanu uh kongpi-a khua sung upate kiangah tu nungak lak tel ding uh hi.
Tua nu’ pa in upate kiangah, ‘Keimah in hih mipa kiangah ka tanu ka pia a, ahih hangin amah in deih lo hi.

Tu-in amah in, ‘Na tanu’ sungah nungakna lim ka mu kei hi,’ cihna tawh a zumhuai-in mawhsak a, ahih hangin hih lai ah ka tanu’ nungakna kilatna lim om hi,’ ci ding hi. Tua khit ciangin amaute in khuapi upate mai-ah tua puan zalkhia ding hi.
Tua tak ciangin tua khuapi upate in tua mipa manin dantat ding hi;

Amaute in ngun shekel 100 liausak ding uh a, a numei’ pa kiangah pia ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in Israyl nungak tungah minsia tun hi. Tua nu pen ama zi hisuak ding a, amah in a nuntak sung tawntung ma thei lo ding hi.
Ahi zongin, ama mawhsakna pen a man thu hi-in, nungak hihna lim a kimuh kei leh,

numei pen a pa’ inn kongkhak ah kipaipih ding a, a khua sung mite in suangtum tawh deng lum ding uh hi. Amah in a pa’ inn sungah a om lai-in paktat gamtatna tawh Israyl sungah vang a kiamsakin gamta hi. Hih bang danin note lak panin siatna na beisiangsak ding uh hi.
Pasal nei numei khat tawh a lum khawm pasal khat a kimuh leh, numei tawh a lum pa leh a numei zong a nih tuak un kithat ding hi. Hih bang danin note lak panin siatna na beisiangsak ding uh hi.
A kidongsa nungak khat, khuapi sungah pasal khat in mu-in amah tawh a lupkhop leh,

tua ciangin note in a nih tuak un tua khuapi kongpi panin na paikhiatpih ding uh a, tua numei kiko khia lo ahih manin leh tua pasal in a mipihte’ zi va suksak ahih manin, suangtum tawh na denglum ding uh hi. Hih bang danin note lak panin siatna na beisiangsak ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin pasal khat in a kidongsa nungak khat gamlak ah tuakin, mipa in tua nu buanin a luppih leh, tua nu tawh a lum mipa bek kithat ding hi.
A numei tungah bangmah na ci peuhmah kei ding uh hi; amah in sihna dingin mawhna bangmah a khial kei hi. Hih bang thu pen mi khatpeuh in a sanggampa do-in a thah tawh kibang hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh mipa in gamlak ah numei mu-in, numei in huh ngen dingin a kiko hangin, tua lai-ah a huh ding kuamah om lo hi.
Pasal khat in a kidong nai lo nungak khat tuakin, tua numei buanin luppih a, amau tegel a kimuh leh,

tua nu a luppi mipa in nungaknu’ pa tungah ngun shekel sawmnga pia ding a, tua numei ama zi hi ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in nungaknu va su khin hi. Amah in a nuntak sung tawntungin tua nu a mak ding kiphal lo ding hi.
Pasal khat in a pa’ zi tenpih lo ding hi; amah in a pa’ lupna daisak peuhmah lo ding hi.
A ciltang a kitam ahih keileh, a pasal na a cing lo mi kuamah, Yahweh’ mihonpi tawh kisai-in kingaihsun lo ding hi.
Zawlta ahi a, a suanlekhakte ahi zongin Yahweh’ mihonpi lakah lut lo ding hi; a suan a khak khang sawmna dong nangawn lut lo ding hi.
Ammon mite ahi a, Moab mite ahi a, amau’ suanlekhakte ahi zongin Yahweh’ mihonpi lakah lut lo ding a, a suan a khak khang sawmna dong nangawn lut lo ding uh hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh Egypt gam panin note na paikhiat uh ciangin lampi ah an leh tui tawh amaute in note hong dawn lo uh a, note tungah samsia hong pia dingin Aram Naharaim gam; Mesopotamia leilu-nitum lam gam, Pethor khua panin Beor’ tapa Balaam a cial uh hi.
Ahi zongin Yahweh na Pa un Balaam’ thu ngai loin, samsiatna pen note aa dingin thupha a suah hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh na Pa un note hong it hi.
Na nuntak lai tengun, amaute nopsakna ding ahi a, amaute tawh sanggam bangin kikholh theih nading na zong kei ding uh hi.

Ahi zongin Edom mite na mudah kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute pen na sanggamte uh ahi hi. Egypt mite na muhdah kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh note pen amau’ gam sungah minam dangin na om uh hi;
Amau’ sung pana piang a khang thumna mite-a kipan Yahweh’ mihon lak ah lut thei ding uh hi.
Na galte uh a do dingin giahphual na sat uh ciangin, a siangtho lo na peuhmah panin na kikem ding uh hi.
Zan sungin bawltui khahkhia, na mite uh khatpeuh a om leh, giahphual pualam ah amah paikhia ding a, tua lai mun ah om ding hi.
Ahih hangin nitak lam ciangin amah kisil ding a, ni tum ciangin giahphual ah ciahkik thei ding hi.
Giahphual pua ah awnghawh nading mun khat na nei ding uh hi.
Na galhiamte uh banah lei kuak tawh nading khat na nei ding uh a, awng na hawh ding uh ciangun lei na to kuak masa ding uh a, tua khit ciangin na ek uh na vuk ding uh hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh note hong hon ding leh note’ mai-a na galte uh hong pia dingin Yahweh na Pa uh na giahphual laizang uh ah hong pai hi; tua ahih manin na giahphual uh pen a siangtho-in om pelmawh ding hi; tua hileh Amah in note lakah a siang lo na mu lo ding a, note kiang panin kiheikhia lo ding hi.
Sila khat, a pu kiang panin note lakah a bu dingin hong tai leh, a pu kiangah na apkik kei ding uh hi.
Na khuapite uh lak panin note lak ama utna peuh ahih keileh ama aa dingin a hoih penna mun ah amah teng thei ding hi; Amah na simmawh peuhmah kei ding uh hi.
Israyl’ tapate leh tanute, milim biakna biakinn a kihhuai ngeinate sungah kizuakna leh sodom paktatna bangin a paktat kuamah om lo ding hi.

A kizuak numei’ kiguaihna ahi a, a kizuak pasal’ kiguaihna ahi zongin thuciamna khat peuhpeuh piakna-in Yahweh na Pa uh Inn sungah na paipih kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh hih tegel pen Yahweh na Pa uh aa dingin a kihhuai ahi hi.
Sum ahi a, an ahi a, a met lak theih ding na khat peuhpeuh ahi zongin, na sanggampa’ tungah a met na la peuhmah kei ding hi.

Gamdang mipa tungah a met na la thei ding a, ahih hangin na sanggampa tungah a met na la peuhmah kei ding uh hi; tua hih leh Yahweh na Pa un sem dingin na khut na ngakna khempeuh leh luah dingin na lutna gam sungah note thupha hong pia ding hi.
Yahweh tungah kiciamna na bawl uh leh, tangtunsak dingin na zekai peuhmah kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh na Pa un hong kal teekteek ding a, note tungah khialhna hong hi ding hi.
Ahih hangin thuciamna bawl ding pan na kikep uh leh, note na khial kei ding uh hi.
Na kam uh panin a gingkhia peuhmah pel loin na tunsak ding uh ahi hi; bang hang hiam cihleh note in no mau’ kam mahmah tawh nomau’ utthu-in suakta takin Yahweh na Pa uh tungah na kiciam uh hi.
Na sanggampa’ leenggui lo ah na lut uh ciangin, na duh zahzah uh na ne thei ding uh a, ahih hangin khol theihna khatpeuh sung uh na guang kei ding uh hi.
Na sanggampa’ buhkung ding laite lakah na pai uh ciangin na khut uh tawh a vuite na zut thei ding uh a, ahih hangin phiaukawi tawh a buhkung ding laite na atsak peuhmah kei ding uh hi.

Pasal khat in numei khat tenpihin, amah in tua nu sungah siantho lohna pawlkhat a muhna hangin ama aa dingin a lungkimhuai lo numei ahih leh, amah in kikhenna lai gelh ding a, tua nu tungah pia-in, a inn panin sawlkhia ding hi—
A inn panin tua nu a paikhiat khit ciangin, amah pen pasal dang khat’ zi a suah leh,
tua mipa in zong tua nu a muhdah gawp leh, kikhenna lai gelh ding a, tua nu tungah pia-in, a inn panin sawlkhia ding hi—tua bang ahih keileh tua mipa si-in tua nu meigongin a nusiat leh,

tua numei a sawlkhia a pasal masa in, tua nu a kinitsak khit ciangin a zi dingin lakik thei nawn lo ding hi. Tua pen Yahweh mai-ah a kihhuai hi a, Yahweh in luah dingin note hong piakna gam ah mawhna na tun peuhmah kei ding uh hi.

Pasal khat a zi neih zawh a sawt nai kei leh, gal sungah na paisak kei ding uh a, tavuan dang khat peuhpeuh zong na guan kei ding uh hi; A laksa a zi tungah tungnopna a tun dingin inn-ah kum khat sung suakta takin om ding hi.
Leiba hangin khapna-in angawina ahi a, an gawina suangpeek a tungnungzaw ahi zongin la kei un; bang hang hiam cihleh khapna-in mipa’ nuntakna a la suak ding hi.

Mi khat in Israyl mi a sanggamte khat gu-in, amah in sila bangin a bawl ahi a, a zuak ahi zongin a kimat leh, tua mi a gupa pel loin kithat ding hi. Hih bang danin note lak panin siatna na beisiangsak ding uh hi.

Phaknatna ahih keileh a kilawh thei vun natna a om sungin Levi mi ahi siampite hong genna leh note hong hilhna bang teekteekin hihin na gamtat ding uh thei gige un. Amaute ka thupiakna bangin limtakin na zui ding uh hi.
Egypt gam panin note na paikhiat uh lai-un lampi ah Yahweh na Pa un Miriam’ tungah a hihna phawk un.
Na sanggampa tungah na khat peuhpeuh leitawi na piak uh ciangin khapna-in ama hong piak ding khatpeuh a la dingin a inn ah pai kei in.
A pualam ah na ding ding uh a, mipa in nang kiangah a khapna hong paipih ding hi.
Amah mizawng ahih leh, ama hong khapna puan tungsilh tualpi na zantaamsak peuhmah kei ding hi.

Hih thu ah ni a tumsuk ma-in ama puan tungsilh tualpi na piakkik pelmawh ding hi; tua hileh amah in a puan silhin lum thei ding hi. Tua tak ciangin amah in nang thupha hong pia ding a, tua pen nang aa dingin Yahweh na Pa mai-ah thumanna-in kiseh ding hi.
A zawng a cimawh mi ahi a kicial mipa, na sanggamte khat ahi a, na khuapite uh sunga hong peem khualmi khat ahi zongin a met na dok kei ding uh hi.

Ni tum ma-in ama thaman ni simin na pia ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah pen mizawng hi a, tua tungah kinga hi. Tua bang ahih keileh amah in nang hong mawhsakin Yahweh tungah kiko ding a, a mawh na hi ding uh hi.
A tate hangin pate kithat lo ding a, tate zong a pate hangin kithat lo ding hi. Mi khat pen ama mawhna hang bekin kithat hamtang ding hi.
Khualmi’ thu ahi a, pa nei nawn lo mi’ thu ahi zongin tuate aa dingin thutang na heikhiatsak kei ding uh a, meigong numei’ puan tungsil tualpi zong khapna-in na laksak kei ding uh hi.
Egypt gam sungah sila na hihna uh leh Yahweh na Pa un tua lai mun panin note hong hotkhiatna na phawk gige ding uh hi. Na hih dingun hih bangin thu kong piakna hang pen tua hang ahi hi.

Na lo sung uh ah an la-in, anlom na lak mangngilh uh a om ciangin, a la dingin na paikik peuhmah kei ding uh hi; tua pen khualmi adingin, pa nei nawn lote ading, leh meigongte aa dingin na hisak ding uh hi; tua hileh Yahweh na Pa un na khutte uh tawh na sepna khempeuh ah thupha hong pia ding hi.
Na olive kungte uh na sat uh ciangin, a hiangte na sat kikkik kei ding uh hi; tuate pen khualmite ading, pa nei nawn lote ading leh meigongte ading na hisak ding uh hi.
Na leenggui lo panin leenggahte na lak uh ciangin, a sang na nung khopkik kei ding uh hi; tuate pen khualmite ading, pa nei nawn lote ading leh meigongte ading na hisak ding uh hi.
Egypt gam sungah sila na hihna uh na phawk gige ding uh hi. Na hih dingun hih bangin thu kong piakna hang pen tua hang ahi hi.
Mite kikalah thu kineihna a om ciangin, thukhen zum ah amaute pai-in, tua ahih manin thukhente in a dikpa khahin a mawh pa dantat dingna tawh a thu uh khensak ding hi.
A khial pa satna thuak dinga a kilawm ahih leh, thukhenpa in amah lumsuksak ding a, a khialhna tawh kituakin khauzen tawh ama muhin satsak ding a,
ahih hangin khauzen sawmli val satsak vet lo ding hi. Mipa pen tua sangin a tamzaw-in a kisat leh, note muhna ah na sanggampa uh a kineu bawl suak ding hi.
Bawng in an a cil laitakin a muk tuamsak kei in.

Sanggam pasalte teng khawmin, tapa nei loin amaute khat a sih uh leh, a sipa’ zi in innkuan pualam khatpeuh tawh kiteng peuhmah lo ding hi. A pasal’ sanggampa in tua nu la-in, tua nu tungah pasal’ sanggampa vaipuak a sem dingin tenpih ding hi.
Tua nu’ neih masak a tapa in a sisa a pasal’ min pua ding hi; tua hileh Israyl-te kiang panin ama min maimang lo ding hi.
