Ahih hangin mipa in a sanggampa’ meigongnu a tenpih nop kei leh, khuapi kongpi-a upate kiangah tua nu pai ding a, ‘Ka pasal’ sanggampa in Israyl sungah a sanggampa’ min puak ding nial hi. Amah in a sanggampa’ vaipuak kei tungah hong sem nuam lo hi,’ ci ding hi.
Tua tak cianign a khuapi upate in tua mipa samsak ding a, amah thu genpih ding uh hi. Amah in, ‘Tua nu ka tenpih nuam kei hi,’ ci-in kiptakin a din leh,

upate omin a sanggampa’ meigongnu pen ama kiangah paito-in a khe panin a khedap kaihkhiatsakin a maitang cilphih ding hi. Tua ciangin tua nu in, ‘Hih pen a sanggampa’ innkuan a zomto lo mipa kibawl dan ahi hi,’ ci ding hi.
Tua ciangin Israyl sungah tua pa min pen, ‘A khedap kisuah khiatsak mipa’ innkuan,’ kici ding hi.
Mi nih a kilai-in, a velpa’ kiang panin a pasal a honkhia dingin a khat pa’ zi hong pai-in, amah in a khut zankhia-in mipa’ zahmawh panin a mat leh,
tua nu khut na sattansak ding uh a, na hehpih kei ding uh hi.
Na ipsung uh ah tawisuang a kibang lo nih, a gik leh a zang, na neikhawm kei ding uh hi.
Na inn sungah a kibang lo van tehna nih, a neu leh a lian, na neikhawm kei ding uh hi.
Tawisuang a cing, a man, na nei ding uh a, van tehna a cing, a man, na nei ding uh hi; tua hileh Yahweh na Pa un note hong piakna gam sungah na nuntak uh sau ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh a diktat lote leh a thuman gamtat lote khempeuh Yahweh na Pa uh tungah a kihhuai ahi hi.
Egypt panin na paikhiat lai-un lampi-ah Amalek mite in note hong bawlna thei un;
note gimin lungkhamin na om laitakun Amalek-te in lampi ah note hong pangin, note’ nunglam-a mi phazo lote khempeuh hong thahsak hi. Amalek-te in Yahweh zahtak lo uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh na Pa un note neih dingin gamh-in hong piak gam sungah, Yahweh na Pa un na kiimkot uha na galte khempeuh panun tawlngakna hong piak ciangin, vanpi nuai panin Amalek mite a phawkna na phiat maimang ding uh hi. Hih thu mangngilh kei un!
Yahweh na Pa un luah dingin note hong piakna gam sungah na tungin, tua gam luahin, a sungah na ten uh ciangin,

Yahweh na Pa un note hong piaksa leitang panin a piang, leitunga gah khempeuh panin gah masa pawlkhat na la hamtang ding uh hi; tuate lawh khat sungah na koih ding uh a, Yahweh na Pa un Ama Min phuh nadinga a teelna mun ah na pai ding uh hi.
Tua hun lai-in na a sem siampi khat kiangah, ‘Yahweh in kote piak dingin ka pu ka pate uh tungah a ciam leitang ah ka tunkhitna uh tu ni-in Yahweh ka Pa kiangah kong ko uh hi,’ na ci ding uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin siampipa in na khut panin tua lawh hong la ding a, Yahweh na Pa uh biaknatau mai-ah koihsuk ding hi;

Tua ciangin note in Yahweh na Pa uh mai-ah, ‘Ka pa uh pen a zin kawikawi Aram mi hi a, mi tawmno khat tawh Egypt gam sungah amah paisukin tua lai mun ah tenga, amah pen minam lian, a thahat, tampi a pha khat a suak hi.
Ahih hangin Egypt mite in kote hong ngong bawlin hong gimsak a, kote tungah sal bangin hong bawl uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yahweh, ka pu ka pate uh Pa kiangah ka kiko uh a, Yahweh in kote’ aw hong za-in, ka gimnate uh, ka sepnate uhleh hong kinetniamnate uh hong mu hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh in vanglian khut, a kizankhia khut, launa lianpi, lim leh na lamdangte tawh Egypt gam panin kote hong paikhiatpih hi.
Amah in hih lai mun ah kote hong paipih a, bawngnawi leh khuaizu luanna ahi hih gam kote hong pia hi.

Tu-in, en in, Yahweh aw, nangmah in kei nong piaksa hih gam’ gah masate kong paipihkhinta hi,’ na ci ding uh hi. Tua khit ciangin note in Yahweh na Pa uh mai-ah tuate na koih ding uh a, Yahweh na Pa uh mai-ah na bia ding uh hi.
Note tung, na innkuanpihte tung, Levi mite tung, leh note laka hong peem khualmite tungah Yahweh na Pa un hong piak na hoih khempeuh tawh lungdam kipaakin na om ding uh hi.

Seh-sawm-suah-seh-khat a Thum veina piak kum ahi, a kum thumna kum sungin na ngah khempeuh uh panin na seh-suahte uh na koihkhiat khit uh ciangin, Levi mite, khualmi, pa nei nawn lote, meigongte na pia ding uh hi; tua hileh amaute in na kulhkongpite sungah ne-in gilvahin om ding uh hi.

Tua ciangin note in Yahweh na Pa uh mai-ah, ‘Keimah in ka innsung panin hih a siangtho sehtanh ahi ka Sehsuah Masa ka hemkhia khin a, Levi mite, khualmite, pa nei nawn lote leh meigongte aa dingin ka Sehsuah Thumna zong, keimah thu nong piaksa Na Thukhamte tawh kizui-in ka piakhin hi. Keimah in Na Thukhamte ka palsat kei a, tuate zong ka mangngilh kei hi.

Pasian khatpeuh (el, teraph) zahtakna tawh ka Sehsuah ka ne ngei kei a, keimah ka siang loh hun sungin zong ka Sehsuah ka hemkhia ngei kei a, misi tungah zong ka Sehsuah khatpeuh zong biakna-in ka pia ngei kei hi. Yahweh ka Pa thu kong mang hi; Nangmah in nong thupiak khempeuh ka hihkhin hi.

A siangtho na tenna, vantung panin hong ensuk inla, bawngnawi leh khuaizu a luanna gam, ka pu ka pate uh tungah na ciamsa bang teekteekin, Na mi Israyl-te leh kote tungah nong piaksa leitang thupha hong pia in,’ na ci ding uh hi.

Tu ni-in Yahweh na Pa un hih ngeina kipte leh thukhennate na zuih ding uh note tungah thu hong pia hi. Tua ahih manin na lungsim khempeuh, na nuntakna khempeuh uh tawh zui-in na gamtat ding uh na ngaihsun gige ding uh hi.
Tu ni-in Yahweh pen na Pa uh ahi dingin leh, Ama lampite zui-in, Ama ngeina kipte, Ama Thukhamte, leh Ama Thukhennate a lenkip ding leh, Ama thu a mang dingin na genkhiakhin uh hi.
Yahweh in hong ciamsa mah bangin note pen Ama mi a tuamte, Ama neih a manphate leh Ama Thukhamte khempeuh a zui dingte na hih nadingun tu ni-in Yahweh in zong genkhiakhin hi.

Amah in a bawlsa minam khempeuh sangin phatna, minthanna, leh pahtawina a ngahzaw dingin note hong sang koih nading leh Amah in hong ciamkhitsa mah bangin Yahweh na Pa uh aa dingin a siangtho mite na hih na ding uh Amah in genkhiakhin hi.
Tua tak ciangin Israyl upate tawh Mosheh in mite thupia-in a gen inah, ‘Tu ni-in note kong thupiak hih Thukhamte khempeuh zui un.
Yahweh na Pa un note hong piakna gam ah pai dingin Yardan na kantan ni-un, note in suangtum pite na phut ding uh a, a belhdikdek tawh na zut ding uh hi.

Na pu na pate uh Pa, Yahweh in note hong ciamsa bangin bawngnawi leh khuaizu a luanna gam, Yahweh in note hong piakna gam ah a lut dingin na galkai uh ciangin, note in hih Thukham-a thute khempeuh tuate tungah na gelh ding uh hi.
Note in Yardan na kantan khit uh ciangin, tu ni-in note kong thupiak bangin Ebal Mual tungah hih suangtumte na phut ding uh a, a belhdikdek tawh na zut ding uh hi.
Suangtumte tawh Yahweh na Pa uh biaknatau lam un. Sik ahi a, sik tawh a kibawl khatpeuh ahi zongin tuate tungah zang kei un.
Yahweh na Pa uh biaknatau lam nadingin a kiseek lo suangtumte zang unla, tua tungah Yahweh na Pa uh aa dingin meihal biaknate na pia ding uh hi.
Note in kilemna biaknate na pia ding uh a, tua lai mun ne-in, Yahweh na Pa uh mai-ah lungdam kipaakin na om ding uh hi;
Na phuhsa uh hih suangtumte tungah hih Thukham-a thute khempeuh kitel takin na gelh ding uh hi,’ a ci uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin Mosheh leh Levi mi siampite in Israyl khempeuh tungah a gen inah, ‘Israyl-te aw, gamdai unla ngai un. Tu ni-in note pen Yahweh na Pa uh mi na suakkhin zo uh hi.
Tu ni-in note kong thupiak ahi Ama Thukhamte leh Ama ngeina kipte zui-in gamtatna tawh Yahweh na Pa uh thu mang un,’ a ci uh hi.
Tua ni mahin Mosheh in mite thupia-in a gen inah:
‘Yardan na kantan khit uh ciangin, mite thupha a pia dingin Gerizim Mual tungah hih minamte ding ding uh hi: Simeon, Levi, Yahdah, Issachar, Yahseph, leh Benyamin ahi hi.
Samsiatnate a genkhia dingin Ebal Mual tungah hih minamte ding ding uh hi: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan leh Naphtali ahi hi;
Levi mite in awging lianpi tawh Israyl mite khempeuh tungah a simkhiat ding unah:

‘Yahweh aa dingin a kihhuai na ahi khutsiampa’ khut tawh a kibawl, a kiseek pasian ahi a, a kisung pasian ahi zongin milim bawlte leh mun simtham ah a koih mi in samsiatna ngah tahen,’ ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in, ‘Tua bangin hi tahen,’ ci ding uh hi.
‘A nu ahi a, a pa ahi zongin pahtawi loin a simmawh mi in samsiatna ngah tahen,’ ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in, ‘Tua bangin hi tahen,’ ci ding uh hi.
‘A vengpa’ huang ciptehna gisuang a khin mi in samsiatna ngah tahen,’ ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in, ‘Tua bangin hi tahen,’ ci ding uh hi.
‘Mittaw pa a khialin lam a lak mi in samsiatna ngah tahen,’ ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in, ‘Tua bangin hi tahen,’ ci ding uh hi.
‘Khualmi, pa nei nawn lo, leh meigongte aa dingin thutang a heikhia mi in samsiatna ngah tahen,’ ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in, ‘Tua bangin hi tahen,’ ci ding uh hi.
‘A pa’ zi tawh nulepa mawhna a bawl mi in samsiatna ngah tahen; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in a pa’ lupna daisak hi,’ ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in, ‘Tua bangin hi tahen,’ ci ding uh hi.
‘Ganhing khatpeuh tawh nulepa mawhna a bawl mi in samsiatna ngah tahen,’ ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in, ‘Tua bangin hi tahen,’ ci ding uh hi.
‘A pa’ tanu ahi a, a nu’ tanu ahi zongin a sanggamnu tawh nulepa mawhna a bawl mi in samsiatna ngah tahen,’ ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in, ‘Tua bangin hi tahen,’ ci ding uh hi.
‘A sungnu tawh nulepa mawhna a bawl mi in samsiatna ngah tahen,’ ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in, ‘Tua bangin hi tahen,’ ci ding uh hi.
‘A sanggampa a that sim mi in samsiatna ngah tahen!’ ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in, ‘Tua bangin hi tahen,’ ci ding uh hi.
‘Mawh nei lo mi thah nadingin sumgolh a la mi in samsiatna ngah tahen!’ ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in, ‘Tua bangin hi tahen,’ ci ding uh hi.
‘Hih Thukham kammal peuhpeuh a lenkip lo mi in samsiatna ngah tahen,’ ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in, ‘Tua bangin hi tahen,’ ci ding uh hi.
Tu ni-in note kong thupiak ahi Ama Thukhamte khempeuh zuihna leh sepna tawh Yahweh na Pa’ thu limtakin na mang uh leh, Yahweh na Pa un leitunga minam khempeuh tungah note hong sang koih ding hi.
Yahweh na Pa’ thu na mang na hih manun hih thuphate khempeuh note tungah hong tung ding hi:
Khuapi sungah thupha ngah mi na hi ding uh a, na gam sung uh ah thupha ngah mi na hi ding uh hi.
Na pumpi pana gahte, na leitang uh pana piangte, na ganhon khanglaite ahi na gankhawina uh pana na bawnghonte leh na tuuhonte i a note in thupha ngah ding hi.
Na seeng uh leh na ansalte un thupha ngah ding hi.
Na sungtum uh ciangin thupha ngah na hi ding uh a, na pusuak uh ciangin zong thupha ngah na hi ding uh hi.
Yahweh in note langa pang na galte note mai-ah hong zawhsak ding hi; amaute lam khat pan hong kuan ding uh a, note kiang panin lam sagihin taikek ding uh hi.
Yahweh in na buhte uh leh ansalte, na khuta na sepsa peuhmah tungah thupha hong tungsak ding hi. Yahweh na Pa un note hong piakna gam ah note thupha hong pia ding hi.
Note in Yahweh na Pa uh Thukhamte zui-in, Ama lampite khempeuh na zuih uh leh, Amah in hong ciamsa bangin Ama tungah a siangtho Ama mi-in Yahweh in note hong kipsak ding hi.
Tua tak ciangin leitunga om mi khempeuh in note, Yahweh Minin hong kisap lam thei-in hong kihta ding uh hi.
Yahweh in note hong piak dingin na pu na pate uh tungah a ciamna gam ah na pumpi pana gahte, na ganhonte, na leitang pana piangte ahi na neihsate uh Yahweh in tampitak hong hausak ding hi.

A hunhunin na gam uh ah guah hong zusak ding leh na khutte tawh na sepna khempeuh uh ah thupha hong pia dingin Yahweh in vantungte leh Ama na manpha tampite kholna inn hong ding hi. Note in minam tampte tungah na leitawisak ding uh a, ahih hangin kuamah kiang panin na leitawi kei ding uh hi.

Yahweh in a meidawn hi loin a lutangin note hong bawl ding hi. Tu ni-in note kong thupiak Yahweh na Pa uh Thakhamte na thupi sim uh a, limtakin na zuih uh leh cikmahin na nuai nungpen kei ding uh a, a tung nungpen bek na hi ding uh hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh’ Thukham khempeuh limtakin zui-in na sep nak uh leh, pasian khatpeuh’ na sem dingin zuihna tawh tuni-a kong thupiak Thukhamte khatpeuh panin taklam ahi a, veilam ahi zongin na pialkhia kei ding uh hi.

Ahi zongin note in Yahweh na Pa uh thu mang loin, tuni-a kong thupiak Ama Thukhamte leh Ama ngeina kipte khempeuh limtakin na zuih kei uh leh, hih samsiatnate khempeuh note tung hong tung ding a, note hong ban ding hi:
Khuapi sungah samsiat na hi ding uh a, na gam sung uh ah samsiat na hi ding uh hi.
Na seeng uh leh na ansalte samsiat hi ding hi.
Na pumpi pana gahte, na leitang uh pana piangte, na ganhon khanglaite ahi na gankhawina uh pana na bawnghonte leh na tuuhonte i a note samsiat ding hi.
Na sungtum uh ciangin samsiat na hi ding uh a, na pusuah uh ciangin samsiat na hi ding uh hi.

Note in Keimah hong nusia-in a sia-a na gamtatna uh hangin na kisiatna uh leh siatpahna hong tun matengin a sem dingin na khut uh na ngakna khempeuh uh ah Yahweh in samsiatna, taina, buaisakna hong sawl ding hi.
Neih dinga na lutna uh gam panin Amah in note hong suksiatkhit matengin note tungah hong belh ding pulnatnate Yahweh in bawl ding hi.
Yahweh in cisa natna tawh, meima nasia tawh, a sa mahmah keutumna tawh, namsau tawh, huihpi tawh, leh a nom tawh note hong vatgawp ding hi; na sihmang matengun note tawh tuate hong om ding hi.
Note lutunga om vantung in sumngo hi ding a, note nuai-a om leitang pen sik hi ding hi.
Yahweh in na gam uha guah pen leivui leh vuikhu suaksak ding a, note hong kisuksiat mateng vantung panin note tungah hong zusuk ding hi.

Yahweh na galte uh mai-ah note hong lelsak ding hi; Amau lam manawhin lam khatin na kuan ding uh a, amaute’ mai panin lam sagihin na taikek ding uh hi. Leitung kumpi gamte khempeuh ah cikzethuai mahmah na suak ding uh hi.
Na luangte uh huih lak vasate, leitung gamsate khempeuh aa dingin an suak ding a, tuate a notkhia kuamah om lo ding hi.
A kidamsak thei lo natna—Egypt meimatum, pumsung natna, meima gulut, leh cithak natna tawh Yahweh in note hong gawt ding hi.
Haina, kha mit mialna, lungsim apkhapna tawh Yahweh in note hong gawt ding hi.

Mittaw khat in miallak a zawt koikoi bang teekteekin suntangpi-in na zawt ding uh hi. Na hihna peuhpeuh ah gualzawhna na ngah kei ding uh a, note hong huh ding kuamah om loin, ni khat khit ni khat hong kinuainetin hong kisut toto ding hi.

Numei khat tenpih dingin zuthawl na pia ding uh a, ahih hangin mi dang khatin la-in tua nu tawh na lumkhawm ding hi. Inn na lam ding uh a, ahih hangin a sungah na teng kei ding uh hi. Leenggui na suan ding uh a, ahih hangin a gahte kaikhawm kei ding uh hi.

Na mittangte mai mahmah ah na bawngtal uh kigo ding a, ahih hangin them zong na ne kha kei ding uh hi. Na kiang panin na laa uh hong kithatang kaihkhiatsak ding a, na kiang hong tungkik nawn lo ding hi. Na galte tungah na tuute kipia ding a, kuamah in tuate hu lo ding hi.
Na et laitak pi mahin minam dang tungah na tapate leh na tanute kipia ding a, tua a khaktan dingin na khut khat na ngawn na liik zo kei ding uh hi.
Na theih ngei loh minam khat in na gam sung gah uh leh na sepna uh pana piangte ne ding uh hi; note in bangmah nei loin hong kinengniamin hong kigawimang ding hi.
Na muhkhitsa uh nate hangin hih bang danin note hong kihaisak ding hi.
Na khetaw panin na luzang dong kizelin, a kidamsak thei lo a na velval meimate tawh Yahweh in na khukte uh leh na khete uh hong gawt ding hi.

Note leh na pate un na theih ngei nai lo uh minam khat kiangah note leh no hong uk dinga na koih uh kumpite Yahweh in hong tunpih ding a, tua lai munah sing leh suang pasiante—piasiante na bia ding uh hi.
Yahweh in note hong hawlkhiat nading muna minamte khempeuh lak ah, a lipkhaphuai, a kiciamnuih bawl leh a kisimmawh mi na suak ding uh hi.
Lo ah khaici tampitak na vawh ding uh a, ahih hangin tawmno bek na la ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh kauphete in tuate netum ding hi.
Leengguite na suanin na puah ding uh a, ahih hangin note in leenggahzu dawnkha kei ding uh a, a gahte zong na kaikhawm kha kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh lung in tuate ne ding hi.
Na gam sung khempeuh uh ah olive kungte na nei ding uh a, ahih hangin sathau na zang kha kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh olive gahte pulhmang ding hi.
Note in tapate leh tanute na nei ding uh a, ahih hangin amaute na keemkha kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute galmatin a paimang ding uh hi.
Kauphe honpi in na singkungte khempeuh leh na gam sunga piangte netum ding hi.
Note laka hong peem khualmipa khang semsem ding a, ahih hangin note na kiamsuksuk ding uh hi.
Amah in note tungah hong leitawi ding a, ahih hangin leitawi na pia zo kei ding uh hi. Amah pen lutang hi ding a, nang pen a meidawn na hi ding uh hi.

Tua bek tham loin note hong kisuksiat matengin hih samsiatna khempeuh nang tungah hong tungin hong sulzuih ding a, hong pha ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Amah in note hong piak Ama Thukhamte, Ama ngeina kipte zuih ding, Yahweh na Pa uh thu na man lohna uh hang ahi bek lel hi.
Hih samsiatnate khempeuh pen nang leh na suanlekhakte tungah a tawntungin lim leh nalamdang dingin om ding hi;
Bang hang hiam cihleh note in nakpi takin na lawhcin hun sungin lungnuamtak leh lungsim kipaak takin Yahweh na Pa uh’ na na sem kei uh hi.

Tua ahih manin gilkial dangtakin, silh-le-ten nei loh leh na khempeuh kitangsap mahmah na tawh Yahweh in note langkhatah a sawl ding na galte’ na na sem ding uh hi; Amah in note hong suksiatkhit matengin Amah in na ngawng uh ah sik hakkol hong vawh ding hi.
Yahweh in a gamlapi, leimong panin note langkhatah, muvanlai leilut bangin, a kampau uh na telloh uh minam,
khanghamte tungah zahtakna a nei lo ahi a, naupangte a hehpih lo ahi zongin thukhualna a nei lo minam khat hong kuansak ding hi.

Note hong kisuksiatkhit matengin amaute in na ganhingnote uh leh na gamsung ankungte uh netum ding uh hi. Note hong kisuksiatkhit matengin an nei lo, leenggahzu thak nei lo, sathau nei lo, bawnghon a no nei lo, tuuhon a no nei loin amaute in hong nusia ding uh hi.

Na muan uh kulh muanhuai sangpipite a puk matengin Na gamsung khempeuh uha khuapite khempeuh hong umcih ding uh hi. Yahweh na Pa un note hong piakna gamsung khempeuh-a na khuapite khempeuh ah note hong umcih ding hi.
Note hong ki-umcih sungin na galte un no hong bawlsiatna na thuakna uh hangin Yahweh na Pa un note hong piaksa no pumpi mahmah pana a gah, na tapate leh na tanute sa na ne ding uh hi.
Ni danga note laka lungnemin a migi pen nangawn in a sanggampa, a it a zi, ahih keileh a om lai sun a tate aa dingin lainatna nei nawn lo ding hi.

Amah in a nek kimlai a tate’ sa thembeek zong kuamah hawm lo ding hi. Na khuapite khempeuh uh hong ki-umcih sungin na galte un no hong bawlsiatna na thuakna uh hangin tua pen nek dingin a neih lai sun hi ding hi.
Note laka lungnemin a ngeksuak numei, amah ngekin a ci neel lua ahih manin a khenuai tawh lei sik ding a ngaihsun ngei vet lo nu in, a it a pasal, amahmah tapa leh tanu,

a naubu pana paikhia a naulamh leh a sung pana piang a tate a pia nuam kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh na khuapite uha note tungah na galte hong bawlsiatin hong umcih-in lunggim hun sungin amah in tuate neksim dinga a sawm ahi hi.
Hih a minthang, a zahtakhuai min, Yahweh na Pa uh na zahtak theih nadingun hih Laibu sunga kigelh Thukham kammalte khempeuh limtakin zui-in na hih kei uh leh,
Yahweh in note leh na suan na khate uh tungah a lauhuai mahmah pulnatna, sauveipi a haksa tuahsiatna, gimna a tuandiak leh a nasia natsaute hong tungsak ding hi.
Note in na kihtak uh Egypt natnate khempeuh zong no tungah hong tungsak ding a, note tungah belh den ding hi.
Hih Thukham Laibu sunga a kigelh lo adang natnate khempeuh leh adang tuahsiatna khempeuh zong note hong kisutsiatkhit matengun Yahweh in note tungah hong tun ding hi.
Yahweh na Pa uh thu mang lo na hih manun ni dangin vana aksite zahin na tam uh hangin tua hun ciangin tawmno bek na omlai ding uh hi.

Note a lawhcing leh tampi pha-in hong bawlna in Yahweh lungkimsakin a lungdamsakna bang teekteekin, note a mawkna hong suahna leh hong suksiatna ah zong Amah lungkim ding hi. Tua ciangin a luah dingin na paina uh gam panin note hong kibotkhia ding hi.

Leimong khat pan mong khat dong, minamte khempeuh lakah Yahweh in note hong thehthang ding hi. Tua lai mun ah note in ahi a, na pu na pate in ahi zongin a theih ngei loh sing leh suang pasiante—pasiante na bia ding uh hi.

Tua minamte lakah note in khawlna ding mun na mu kei ding uh a, na khenuai in zong tawlngak nading mun a mu kei ding hi; ahih hangin tua lai mun ah Yahweh in na lungsim linna, mit gimna (lametna khempeuh damdamin beimangna), lunghihmawhna, bawlsiatna leh lungsim tawlngak theih lohna hong pia ding hi.
Na nuntakna uh pen note mai-a puankhuina khau bangin kikhai ding a, sun leh zanin lauthawngin a tawntungin na nuntawpna uh bang ding hi.
Na lungsimte uh launa tawh a kidimna leh nomau mit mahmah tawh na muhnate uh hangin zingsangin, ‘Nitak hi leh maw!’ na ci ding uh a, nitakin, ‘Zingsang hi leh maw!’ na ci ding uh hi.

Note na zinkik ngei nawn kei ding uh hi, ci-in lampi ah kong gen ahi Egypt gam ah tembaw tawh Yahweh in note hong puakkik ding hi. Tua lai mun, na galte uh kiangah numei leh pasal silate bangin nomau leh nomau na kizuak ding uh a, ahih hangin kuamah in note hong lei lo ding hi,” a ci hi.
Hihte pen Horeb ah Yahweh in Israyl mite tawh a thuciamna banah Moab gam sungah Israyl mite tawh a bawl dinga Yahweh in Mosheh thu a piak thuciamna kammalte ahi hi.

Mosheh in Israyl khempeuh sam a, amaute kiangah, “Pharaoh tung, ama uliante khempeuh tung leh ama gam khempeuh tungah—Egypt gam sungah Yahweh in note mittang mai-ah a manin a hihna khempeuh na mukhin uh hi.
Note mit mahmah un tua thusitna lianpite, lim leh nalamdang lianpite na mukhin uh a,
ahih hangin tuni mahmah dong Yahweh in tel theihna lungsim hong pia lo a, na mitte un mu loin na bilte un zong za lo hi.
Sehnel gam sungah kum 40 kong makaihkhin hi; note tung panin na puansilhte uh patkhia loin, na khe tung panun na khedap kaihte uh zong sia nai lo hi.
Kei pen Yahweh na Pa uh ka hihna note in na theih nadingun anlum na ne kei a, leenggahzu ahih keileh zu khauh zong na dawn kei hi.
Hih teng mun na tun uh ciangin, eite hong do dingin Heshbon kumpipa Sihon leh Bashan kumpipa Og hong kuankhia uh a, ahih hangin eite in amaute i zo hi.
Amau’ gam i la a, Reuben leh Gad minamte leh Menasheh minam alangte tungah luah dingin i pia hi.
Tua ahih manin note in thupha ngahin na sepna khempeuh uh ah gual zawhna na ngah thei nadingun hih thuciamna i Thukhamte limtakin zui-in gamta-in na sem ding uh hi.
Tu ni-in note khempeuh—na makaite, na ukpite, na upate, na uliante khempeuh—Israyl sunga pasal khempeuh Yahweh na Pa un mai-ah na ding uh hi;
na zite leh na tate, na giahphual sunga khualmi peuhmah, na sing uh hong ehsakte-a kipan na tui uh hong tawisakte dong hong ding khawm hi.
Tu ni-in Yahweh in note tawh hong bawl, kiciamna tawh seal a tup thuciamna ahi Yahweh na Pa uh thuciamna sungah na kihel theih nadingun hih lai mun ah note na ding uh hi;
Amah in na pu na pate uh ahi Abraham, Isaac leh Yaaqob tungah kiciamin note hong ciamna bang teekteekin Amah pen note Pa ahih nadingin Ama mi dingin tu ni-in note hong kipsak nading ahi hi.
Kiciamna tawh hih thuciamna pen note bek tawh a bawl hi loin,
tu ni-in hih lai mun ah a ding note leh tu ni-in hih lai mun ah a ding lote tawh zong a bawl ahi hi.
Nomau mahmah in Egypt gam sungah i tenna leh hih lai mun lampi-a gamte i nawkna bangci bang hiam cih na thei uh hi.
Note in amaute laka sing, suang, ngun leh kham pasiante ahi a kihhuai pasiante (elohim leh teraphim-te) na mu uh hi.

Note lakah pasal ahi a, numei ahi a, beh ahi a, minam ahi zongin tua minamte’ pasiante kiangah pai-in a bia dingin Yahweh i Pa kiang panin tu ni-in a lungsim a heikhia a om khak ding launa leh note lakah gu a nei gah kha a gah singkung (gu leh a kha—pasian-biakna gamtattatna) in zungkha-in a om khak ding launa hangin, thuciamna leh kiciamna sungah na kihel nadingun lungsim takpi tawh hong thuum ka hi hi.

Hih kiciamna kammalte a zak ciangin a lungsim ah amah leh amah hikisa-in, ‘Keima thu-in ka gamtatsuak nangawn hangin zong ka suakta veve ding hi,’ ci-in khial takin a ngaihsut khak ngei loh nadingin thuciamna leh kiciamna sungah na kihel nadingun lungsim takpi tawh hong thuum ka hi hi. Uangtakin ama gamtatna ahi ama mawhnate khempeuh Yahweh in lenkip ding hi. Amah pen a kikem zo nawn lo zukham mipa bang ahi hi.

Yahweh in amah cikmahin maisak nuam lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in suksiatna meikuangkhiasak ding a, Ama hazatna in tua mipa kangtum ding hi. Hih Laibu sunga a kigelh samsiatnate khempeuh ama tungah tung ding a, Yahweh in van nuai panin ama min phiatkhia ding hi.
Hih Thukham Laibu sunga kigelh thuciamna pana samsiatnate khempeuh tawh kizui-in, haksatna a thuak dingin Israyl minamte khempeuh panin Yahweh in amah tang lakkhiat ding hi.

Tua khit ciangin hong khanglai ding, note nungah hong piang na tate uh leh a gamla gam panin a hong pai gamdang mite in, tua gam tungah a piang suksiatna leh Yahweh in tua gam ah a tunsak natnate mu ding uh hi.

A gam bupi pen kaat leh ci suak ding a—bangmah kisuan loin bangmah zong sel lo a, tua lai muh ah ankung khatbeek zong po lo ding hi. Tua pen Yahweh in Ama hehna leh sinsona tawh a lotthal Sodom leh Gomorrah, Admah leh Zeboiyim-te suksiatna bang hi ding hi.
Hih minamte khempeuh in, ‘Yahweh in hih leitang ah bang hangin hih bangin hih ahi hiam? Hih hehna lianpi bang a cihna ahi hiam?’ ci ding uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin a dawnna pen, ‘Amah in Egypt gam panin a paikhiatpih lai-in amaute tawh a bawl, a pu a pate uh Pa ahi Yahweh’ thuciamna amaute in a nusia uh hi.
Amaute paikhia-in amaute in a theih loh uh pasiante, Yahweh in amaute tungah a piak ngei loh pasiante—amaute in pasiante na semin kunin a biakna uh hang ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh’ hehna amau’ gam tungah kuang a, Amah in hih Laibu sunga a kigelh samsiatna peuhmah tungsak hi.
Hehna, sinsona, thangpaihna tawh Yahweh a leitang uh panin amaute botkhia-in, tu ni-a mah bangin adang gam ah amaute bukhum hi,’ kici ding hi.

Thusimte pen Yahweh i Pa aa hi a, ahih hangin tua thu pen eite tungah hong kilaak hi; Yahweh’ kam panin hong pusuak kammal peuhpeuh eite leh i tate aa hi tawntung hi; tua ahih manin eite in hih Thukham’ kammalte khempeuh zui-in i gamta thei hi.
Hih thute khempeuh note tungah hong pian ciangin, note mai-a ka koih thuphate leh samsiatnate, Yahweh na Pa un note hong thehthangna minamte lakah hih thute phawkkik un;
Note leh na tate un Yahweh na Pa uh kiangah ka ciahkik uh ciangin, tu ni-in sep dingin note kong thupiaksa bang teekteekin na lungsim khempeuh, na nuntakna khempeuh tawh Ama thu na mang un.
Tua tak ciangin Yahweh in saltanna hong lakik ding a, note tungah hehpihna hong nei-in, Amah in note hong thehthangna minamte khempeuh kiang panin note hong kaikhawmkik ding hi.
Leitunga a gamla pen mun nangawn ah note hong kihawlkhiat leh zong, tua lai mun panin Yahweh na Pa un note hong kaikhawm ding a, tua lai mun panin Amah in note hong la ding hi.
Yahweh na Pa un na pu na pate uh neihsa gam ah hong paipih ding a, tua ciangin note in na luah ding uh hi. Amah in na pu na pate uh sangin a lawhcing zaw leh a tamzaw-in note hong bawl ding hi.
Yahweh na Pa un, na lungsim khempeuh leh na nuntakna khempeuh tawh amah it-in na nuntak theih nadingun na lungsimte, na tate uh lungsimte ahi lungsim vun hong at ding hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yahweh na Pa un hih samsiatnate khempeuh na galte uh tung, no hong mudahte tung leh no hong bawlsiate tungah koih ding hi.

Note in Yahweh’ thu mangkikin, tu ni-a note kong thupiak Ama Thukhamte khempeuh na zuikik ding uh hi. 9-10 Hih Thukham Laibu sungah a kigelh Ama Thukhamte leh Ama ngeina kipte zuih nadingin Yahweh na Pa uh thu na man uh a, na lungsim khempeuh, na nuntakna khempeuh uh tawh Yahweh na Pa uh lamah na kihei uh leh, Yahweh na Pa un na khutte tawh na sepna khempeuh, na pumpi pana gahte, na gankhawite uh leh na leitang pana piangte khempeuh ah thupha tampi hong ngahsak ding hi. Na pu na pate uh tungah Amah a lungdam mah bangin note tungah Yahweh hong lungdam ding a, note hong lawhcingsak ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh tu ni-in note kong thupiak hih Thukham pen note kiang panin kisel loin, note zuih lah ding zong hi lo hi.
‘Eite in tua thute za-in i zuih theih nadingin eite aa dingin vantungah kua kahto-in eite kiangah kua in hong paipih ding ahi hiam?’ ci-in na cih nadingun zong tuate pen vangtunga om hi lo hi.
‘Eite in tua thute za-in i zuih theih nadingin, kua in tuipi kantanin eite kiangah hong paipih ding ahi hiam?’ ci-in na cih nadingun zong tuate pen tuipi gal-a om zong hi lo hi.
Thukham pen note tawh kinai mahmah hi: tua pen na kamsung leh na lungtang sungah om hi; tua ahih manin tua thu mang in.
En in, thumanna hangin nuntakna, leh sihna leh suksiatna tu ni-in note mai-ah ka koih hi.

Ama lampite zuihna tawh, Ama Thukhamte, Ama ngeina kipte leh Ama thukhennate zuihna tawh Yahweh na Pa uh na it nadingun tua sungah tu ni-in note thu kong pia hi; tua hileh note nungta-in tampi na pha ding uh a, tua ahih manin note in luah dingin na paina uh gam ah Yahweh na Pa un note thupha hong pia ding hi.
Ahih hangin na lungsim uh kihei-in, note in thumang loin omin, pasiante tungah a kipia ding leh amau na sepna tawh pasiante a bia dingin note hong kizolkhiat leh,
Note na kisiat taktak ding thu tu ni-in keimah in kician takin kong gen hi; luah dingin Yardan na kantan na uh gam ah sauvei na nungta kei ding uh hi.

Nuntakna leh sihna, thuphate leh siamsiatnate, note mai-ah ka koih theih nadingin tu ni-in note langah teci dingin vantung leh leitung ka sam hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh thumanna leh gitlohna, nomau mahmah in suakta takin na teel thei uh hi—tua ahih manin nuntakna teel un, tua hileh note leh na tate uh nungta ding hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Ama thu ngaihna leh Ama thu manna tawh Yahweh na Pa uh na it ding uh hi. Amah pen nuntakna ahih manin Amah na kiplet ding uh hi. Amah in na pu na pate uh ahi Abraham, Isaac leh Yaaqob tungah piak dingin a ciamna gam ah Amah in note kum tampi zong hong pia ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Mosheh pai-in Israyl khempeuh kiangah hih kammalte genin,
amah in amaute kiangah, “Tu ni-in kei pen kum 120 ka hi hi. Yahweh in keima kiangah, ‘Hih Yardan na kantan peuhmah kei ding hi,’ hong cikhin ahih manin ka sungtum ka pusuak zo nawn kei hi.

Note mai-ah Yahweh mahmah in kantan ding hi. Amah in note mai panin hih minamte susia ding a, note in amau gam’ neihsa na la ding uh hi. Yahweh in a gensa bangin Nun’ tapa Yahshua in zong note mai-ah kantan ding hi.
Yahweh in amaute a suksiat ciangin Amor mite’ kumpite ahi Sihon leh Og, leh amau gam tungah a hih bangin amaute tungah hih ding hi.
Yahweh in note tungah hong pia ding a, keimah in amaute suksiat beimang dingin note kong thupiakna khempeuh, amaute tungah na pel loin na hih ding uh hi.

Thahat unla hang un. Amaute kihta kei unla, amaute hangin zong liing kei un; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh na Pa uh note tawh hong pai ding a, Amah in cikmahin note hong taisan lo ding a, zong hong nusia lo ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua khit ciangin Mosheh in Yahshua sam a, Israyl khempeuh muhin ama kiangah thu genin, “Thahat inla hang in; Yahweh in na pu na pate uh tungah piak dingin a ciamsa gam ah hih mite tawh pel loin na pai ding a, amaute lakah amau gamh luah ding na hawmsak pelmawh ding hi.
Yahweh mahmah nangma mai-ah pai-in nang tawh hong om ding hi. Amah in cikmahin nang hong nusia lo ding a, zong hong taisan lo ding hi. Lau peuhmah kei inla zong lungkia kei in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Mosheh in hih Thukham gelhkhia-in, Yahweh’ thuciamna singkuang a pua ahi Levi suan siampite kiang leh Israyl upate khempeuh kiangah a pia hi.
Tua khit ciangin Mosheh amaute thupia-in a gen inah, “Kum sagih a cin sim, a kisehsa suahtaksakna hun; leibate a kimaisak nading a kiseh hun, Buk Pawi ah,
Yahweh in a teel nading mun, Yahweh na Pa uh mai-ah Israyl khempeuh a kilaak dingin a pai uh ciangin, Israyl khempeuh zakin amaute mai-ah hih Thukham pel loin na sim ding uh hi.

Numei, pasal, naupangte leh na khuapite sunga peemtate in a zak theih nading leh hih Thukham kammalte khempeuh limtakin zuihna leh sepna tawh Yahweh na Pa uh a zaktak dan ding a theih nadingin—mipite kaikhawm un.
Hih bang danin, hih Thukham a thei lo a tate un za ding uh a, Yardan kantanin na neih ding uh gam ah na ten laitengun Yahweh na Pa a kizahtak zia ding a thei ding uh hi,” a ci hi.

Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “En in, na sih ding hun hong nai ta hi. Yahshua sam inla, zum makai dingin amah ka seh nading mun Kikhopna Puanbuk ah na nih tuakun hong pai un,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin Mosheh leh Yahshua hong pai a, Kikhopna Puanbuk ah a va om uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin Puanbuk-a meii khuampi sungah Yahweh kilang a, Puanbuk lutna tungteng ah meii a kitung hi.

Yahweh in Mosheh kiangah, “En in, nang pen na pu na pate tawh a tawlnga ding na hi ta hi; amaute lutna ding uh gama pasiante kiangah hih mite a sawt loin amau leh amau paktat tawm ding uh hi; amaute in Kei hong taisan ding uh a, amaute tawh ka bawl thuciamna palsat ding uh hi.

Tua ni ciangin amaute tungah ka heh ding a, amaute ka taisan ding hi. Amaute kiang panin Ka maitang ka seel ding a, a kisiamang ding uh hi. Gitlohna leh buaina tampi amaute tungah tung ding a, tua ni ciangin amaute in, ‘Eite tawh i Pa hong om lohna hangin eite tungah hih bang haksatnate hong tung hi lo ahi hiam?’ ci ding uh hi.
A kikham pasiante lamah kiheina tawh a gamtat uh gitlohna hangin tua ni ciangin Ka maitang ka seel taktak ding hi.

Tu-in hih pen nang aa dinga a kigelh a Bukim Thukham ahi hi. Yahweh a zahtak mite aa dingin teci a pang hih a Bukim Thukham ka neih theih nadingin Israyl mite tungah hilh inla, amaute’ kam sungah koih in.

Ahih hangin a pu a pate uh tungah kiciamna tawh ka ciamsa leitang ahi bawngnawi leh khuaizu a luanna gam ah amaute ka paipih ciangin, amaute in a kham takin ne ding uh a, thau ding uh hi; pasiante lamah amaute kihei-in tuate a bia-in— Ka thuciamna palsatin Kei hong simmawh uh leh,

Amaute tungah haksatna leh buaina tampi hong tun ciangin hih a Bukim Thukham in amaute langah teci khatin pang ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh hih pen amau’ suanlekhakte in mangngilh lo ding hi. Kiciamna tawh amaute tungah ka ciamna gam ah amaute ka paipih ma nangawnin hih dingin a vaihawm kholhna ka thei hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Mosheh in tua ni-in hih a Bukim Thukham gelhkhia a, Israyl mite tungah a hilh hi.

Tua khit ciangin Yahweh in Nun’ tapa Yahshua za pia-in a gen inah: Thahat inla hang in; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute tungah ka ciamna gam ah Israyl mite na paipih ding a, nang tawh Kei mahmah kong om ding hi, a ci hi.
Mosheh in Laibu khat sungah hih Thukham kammalte a pat panin a tawp dong a gelhsiang khit ciangin,
amah in Yahweh’ thuciamna singkuang a pua Levi mite tungah thupiakna gen a,
“Hih Thukham Laibu la unla, note langah teci khatin tua lai-ah a om theih nadingin Yahweh na Pa uh thuciamna singkuang gei-ah koih un;

bang hang hiam cihleh note pen a lehdo thei leh a lungkhauhte na hihna uh ka thei hi. Note tawh keimah ka nuntak lai sung, tu ni-in note in Yahweh na leh dodo lai na hih uh leh, keimah ka sihkhit ciangin bangzah takin lehdozaw lai ding na hi uh hiam?
Amaute langah teci-in vantung leh leitung samin, amaute zakin hih kammalte ka gen theih nadingin na minam upate khempeuh leh na uliante ka mai-ah hong kaikhawm un.

Bang hang hiam cihleh keimah ka sihkhit ciangin note na kisiagawp na suah ding uh ka thei a, keimah in note kong thupiaksa lampi panin na pial ding uh hi. Na khutte uh tawh na bawlte uh hangin Yahweh muhna ah note a sia gamta-in Amah na hehsakna ding na hih man un mailam hunte ciangin note tungah siatna hong tung ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Mosheh in Israyl mihonte khempeuh zakna ah hih la a malte a pat panin a tawp dong simkhia hi;
Vantungte aw ngai un, thu ka gen ding hi. Leitung aw za un, ka kam pana kammalte.
Ka hilhna guah bangin kia tahen. Ka kammalte daitui bangin tuaksuk tahen. Lopa sel tunga guahphin bang henla; ankungte tunga guah tampi a zu bang tahen.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh’ Min lian ka tangko ding hi! Yahweh’ liatna phat un!
Amah pen Suangpi ahi hi. Ama nasepte kicing a, Yahweh’ lampite thutang taktak hi! Amah pen thumante’ Pa hi a, khialna bangmah bawl lo hi. Thudikna leh thutanna pen Amah ahi hi.
Ama lamah amaute gamtat sia uh a, amaute a zumhuaina hangin Ama tate hi nawn lo uh hi; amaute pen a lampial a lungsim kawi khang mite ahi uh hi.
A hai, a pil lo mite aw, hih bang dan tawh Yahweh thukkik na hi uh hiam? Amah pen note Pa hi lo ahi hiam? Amah pen note hong bawl hong siam, hong piangsakpa hi lo ahi hiam?
A beisa hunte phawk unla, sawtpi lai-a khangte ngaihsun dih un. Na pa uh dong un, amah in hong gen ding hi; na upate uh dong un, amaute in hong hilhcian ding hi.
Yahweh in minamte amau luah ding pia-in, mihing khempeuh a hawmsak ciangin, Israyl’ tapate a phazah tawh kizui-in mite aa dingin Amah in gamgite a phut hi.
Yahweh’ tanh pen Ama mite ahi hi; Yaaqob pen Ama ngah gamh ahi hi.
Amah in sehnel gam, gam sia leh a thum duldul leikeu mun ah amah mu hi. Yahweh in amah makaih-in thuhilh hi; Amah in a mitnauta bangin kemcing a,
a bu a vil, a note tungah a kha a zap, a khate zakin a note a man, a kha tawh a note a pua muvanlai bang ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh bek in amah makaih a, amah tawh pasian khat zong om lo hi.
Leitung mun sangnate ah Yaaqob a tuang dingin Yahweh in bawl a, tua ahih manin amah in gam laka piangte ne-in, suangpi panin khuaizu huup a, meisuang bangin a khauh suang panin sathau a huup hi;
Bawnghon leh tuuhon panin tuuno leh keelno vakthaute leh nawitui leh nawithau-khal, Bashan tuutal limcipente leh mangbuh hoih pente amah in ne a, leenggahzu san a siang amah in a dawn hi.
Ahih hangin Yeshurun hong thau-in hong tuankhia hi; nangmah thau-in lianpi pha-in, na zol hi. Tua tak ciangin amah in a lian Yahweh nusia hi. Ama Honpa Suangpi a thusim kei hi.
Amaute in a pasiante uh tawh Yahweh kihazasak uh a, hih a kihhuaina tawh Amah hehsak uh hi.
Yahweh aa ahi lo dawite tung, a theih ngei loh uh pasiante tung, a piangtawm pasiante tung, na pu na pate un a biak loh uh pasiante tungah biakna a pia uh hi.
Note ta-in hong nei Suangpi na awlmawh kei uh a, note hong siam ahi i Pa na mangngilh uh hi.
Yahweh in amaute a muh ciangin, a tanute a tapate in Amah hehsak ahih manin Amah in amaute a kih hi.
Tua ciangin Amah in, “Amaute kiang panin Ka maitang ka seel ding hi; amaute pen a lampial khang mite hi uh a, upna a nei lote’ tate ahih manun amaute hun tawpna bangci ding hiam cih ka en ding hi.

Amaute in vangliatna a nei lote tawh Kei hong hazasak uh a, kimanna a nei lo amau’ pasiante uh tawh Kei hong hehsak hi. Mipi khat a hi lote tawh amaute’ hazat theih nadingin ka bawl ding a, bangmah a thei lo mipi khat tawh amaute ka hehsak ding hi.
Ka hehna in mei khat kuangsak khin a, tua in sihna nuai dongah a kang ding hi. Tua in leitung khempeuh leh a tunga ankungte khempeuh kangtum ding a, mualte’ bulpite a kuangsak ding hi.
Amaute tungah suksiatna ka sungvum ding a, amaute’ tungah Ka thaltangte ka zang ding hi.

Tua ciangin gilkialna tawh amaute kangtum ding a, a sa mahmah meikuang, a haltum thei natna leh sihtheih pulnatna tawh amaute kinetum ding hi. Keimah in amaute a pet dingin ha hiam a nei a gilo gamsate leh leivui laka a gupha gulte ka sawl ding hi.
Namsau ahi lo, lauluatna in tangval leh nungak, naungek leh a sam kang putekte susia ding hi.
Keimah in, ‘Amaute ka thehthang ding a, mite lak panin amaute a kiphawk ka beisak ding hi,’ ka ci hi.
Ahih hangin a langte in ngaihsun khialin, ‘Ko khut mah a gualzo hi, hih khempeuh Yahweh sepsa hi kei,’ hong ci kha ding uh ahih manin galte hong zahpih ding ka lau hi.
Amaute pen ngaihsutna a nei lo minam hi a, amaute in thu theihtelna nei lo uh hi.
Hih minamte a pil hi henla, amaute in hih thu theitelin, a hun tawpna bangci ding cih thei le uh maw!
A Suangpi un amaute zuakkhin lo hi leh, bangci bangin mi khat in tul khat nungdelh thei ding ahi hiam? Yahweh in amaute piakkhia lo hileh, mi nih in tul sawm dozo ding ahi hiam?
Bang hang hiam cihleh amau’ suangpi pen eite Suangpi bang hi lo hi! I galte nangawn in hong theih pih uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh amau leengguite pen Sodom pan leh Gomorrah-a lote pana leengguite ahi hi. Amau’ leenggahte pen gu pana leenggahte hi a, a leenggah-bawkte pen a kha tawh kidim hi.
A leenggahzu uh pen gulpi gu leh a gupha gulgunei gu ahi hi.
Hihte Kei kiangah kikholin Ka van manpha lakah kisincip lo ahi hiam?
Phulakna leh thukkikna pen Kei aa ahi hi! A hun ciangin a khe uh tal ding hi. Amau tuahsiat ni ding nai ta a, amaute tungah siatna hong tungpah ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh mite a thahatna bei-in sila leh sila lo khat beek a om nawn lohna a muh ciangin Yahweh in Ama mite thu khen ding a, Ama nasemte tungah hehpihna nei ding hi.
Tua khit ciangin Amah in, ‘Na pasiante uh, na muan mahmah uh na suangpi uh koi-ah om ahi hiam?
Na biakpiaknate uh a ne, leenggahzu tawh na biaknate uh a dawn na pasiante uh koi-ah om ahi hiam? Na pasiante uhthosakin note kihuhsak un! Amaute na kidalna uh hisak un!
‘Kei, Keimah bek, pen Tuapa ka hi hi, Kei tawh PASIAN (EL) khat zong om lo hi! Ka that a, Ka ka hingsak hi! Ka nasak a, Ka damsak hi! Keima khut panin a honkhia thei khatbeek a om lohna thei un.
Keimah in vantung lamah Ka khut ka lamto-in, ‘A nungta tawntung ka hih mah bangin,
a tee ka namsau taatin Ka khut in thukhenna a let ciangin, Keimah in Ka galte tungah phu ka la ding hi! Kei hong mudahte ka thukkik ding hi.
Ka thaltangte sisan ka khamsak ding a, ka namsau in satak a nawmval ding hi; tuate pen galte tungah thukkikna kipatna tawh a kithatte leh salte hi ding hi.

Minamte aw, Ama mite tawh lungdam-kipaak un. Vantungte aw, Amah tawh lungdam-kipaak unla, Ama vantungmi khempeuh in Amah bia uh hen! Amah pen a nasemte aa dingin Sisan-Phu lapa ahi hi. Yahweh in thu khenin a galte tungah thukkikna sem ding a, Ama gam leh Ama mite aa dingin mawhkuhna bawlsak ding hi,’ ci-in a genkhia hi.
Tua ciangin Nun’ tapa Yahshua tawh Mosheh hong pai-in, mite zakna ah hih la a malte khempeuh simkhia hi.
Mosheh in Israyl khempeuh tungah hih lamalte khempeuh a genna a man ciangin,

amah in amaute kiangah, “Na tate un hih Thukham kammalte khempeuh limtakin zui-in a hih nadingun thu na piak theih nadingun tuni-a note tungah kong teci pansa kammalte khempeuh na lungsim uh vom tinten un.

Hihte pen note aa dingin kammal mawkmawk hi lo a—hih Thukhamte pen note aa dingin nuntakna ahi hi; note in Yardan kantanin na neih ding uh gam ah tuate hangin note sauveipi na nungta ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Yahweh in tua ni mahin Mosheh kiangah thu a gen inah:
“Israyl mite kiangah amau luah ngiat dingin ka piakna Canaan gam a en dingin Yericho gal Moab gam sunga om Abarim Mualdungpi-a Nebo Vum ah paito in.
Hor Mual tungah na sanggampa Aaron a si-in a mipihte kiangah a kigawm mah bangin tua lai mun na kahtoh nading mual tungah, nang na si ding a, na mipihte kiangah hong kigawm ding hi.

Zin Sehnel gam sunga om Meribah Kadesh tuite ah Israyl mite muhin Kei tungah gamtatkhialhna, na nih tuakun Kei nong upna uh na kisiasak uh a, Israyl mite laizangah Kei nong siangtho bawl kei uh a, Ka sianthona na letkip lohna uh hangin Yardan hih lampang ah na si ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin nangmah in a gamla pan bekin tua gam na mu ding a, ahih hangin Israyl mite tungah ka piakna gam ah nang na lut kei ding hi.
Hih pen Yahweh mipa ahi Mosheh in a sih ma-in Israyl mite tungah a genkhiat thupha hi a,

amah in, “Sinai panin Yahweh hong pai a, Seir panin amaute tungah suakkhia hi; Paran Mual panin hong taankhia a, a siangthote tul sawm tawh Amah hong pai hi. Ama taklam khut panin amaute aa dingin meikuang Thukham khat hong tung hi.
Mite a it pa nang na hi taktak hi; a siangthote khempeuh Na khut sungah om hi. Nangma khe ah amaute khempeuh kun uh a, Nang kiang panin thuhilhna amaute in sang uh hi;
Mosheh in kote hong piak Thukham tawh Yaaqob mihonte’ neih suak hi.* (To check again with BoY)
Mipi makaite in Israyl minamte khempeuh a kaihkop lai-in Amah pen Yeshurun tungah kumpipa ahi hi.
Reuben nungta henla, sikei hen! Ama mite tawmbek hi kei hen.

Tua ciangin Mosheh in Yahdah’ thu a genna hih ahi hi: Yahweh aw, Yahdah’ kikona hong za inla, ama mite kiangah puak in. Ama khut mahmah tawh amah kidaltawm a, ahih hangin Yahweh in a galte langah huh ding hi, a ci hi.
Amah in Levi’ thu a gen inah, “Na Thummim leh Na Urim, Na pahtawi pen minam khat aa ahi hi. Massah ah amah na ze-et a, Meribah tuite ah amah tawh na ki-el uh hi.

Amah in a nu leh a pa’ thu a gen inah: amaute thupitsakna ka nei kei hi, ci hi. Amah in a sanggamte phawkkha se loin, ama tate mahmah zong thei se lo hi; ahih hangin amah in Na Thukham kemcingin, Na thuciamna a len tinten hi.
Amah in Yaaqob tungah Na thukhennate hilh a, Israyl tungah na Thukham a hilh hi. Amah in Na mai-ah paknamtui biakna pia-in Na biaknatau tungah haltum meihal biaknate a pia hi.
Yahweh aw, ama siamnate ah thupha pia in la, a khut tawh a sepna ah lungkim in. Amaute a din zawh nawn loh dongin amah langpangin a dingto mite’ thahatna vattuk inla, ama galte vatmai in,” a ci hi.

Amah in Benyamin’ thu a gen inah, “Yahweh’ it mipa Ama sungah lungmuang takin om ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Amah in sun tawntungin dal hi. Yahweh’ it mipa Ama liangkote kikalah tawlnga hi,” a ci hi.
Yahseph’ thu, Mosheh in a gen inah, “Yahweh in ama leitang thupha pia-in, tunglam vantung panin a manpha mahmah daituite tawh, nuailam-a om tuithukte tawh,
ni in a hong puakkhit a hoih pente tawh, khapi gahsuah a hoih pente tawh,
tanglai mualte’ citpiakna a hoih pente tawh, tawntung mual neute gahphatnate tawh,

leitunga citpiakna hoih pente leh a kicinna, leh sawlbawk kuang sunga a tengpa pahtawina tawh thupha pia tahen. Hihte khempeuh Yahseph lutungah khawl henla, a sanggam pasalte kiang panin a kikhenkhia mipa’ lutunga kumpi lukhu tungah khawl ta hen.

Ama thupitna pen bawngtal tacil bang hi a, a kite pen gamlak bawngtal ki tawh kibang hi. Amah in tuate tawh leitung mongte nangawna om minamte siliam ding hi. Amaute pen Ephraim mi tul sawmte leh Menasheh tul tampite ahi uh hi,” a ci hi.
Zebulun’ thu, Mosheh in a gen inah, “Zebulun aw, na paikhiatna ah lungdam-kipaak inla, nang Issachar aw, na puanbukte sungah lungdam-kipaak in.
Amaute in mual tungah mite sam ding uh a, tua lai mun ah thuman taka biakpiakna pia ding uh hi; amaute in tuipite’ bucinna leh sehnel sunga a kisel van manphate-in pawi bawl ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Gad’ thu, amah in a gen inah, “Gad’ gam a zaisak mipa in thupha ngah ahi hi; ban leh a luzang a balkham humpinelkai bangin tua lai mun ah Gad a teng hi.

Amah in ama aa dingin gam hoih pen mun teel a, makaipa’ tanh pen ama aa dingin kikem hi. Makai ahi mite’ lutangte hong kikaihkhop lai-in, Yahweh’ thumanna i a deihna leh Israyl tawh kisai-in Ama thukhennate, amah in semkhia hi,” a ci hi.
Dan’ thu, amah in a gen inah, “Dan pen humpinelkaino hi a, Bashan panin a dingkhia hi,” a ci hi.
Naphtali’ thu, amah in a gen inah, “Naphtali pen pahtawina tawh lungkim a, Yahweh’ thupha tawh kidim hi; amah in leitaw lampang bual dong a luah ding hi,” a ci hi.
Asher’ thu, Mosheh in a gen inah, “Tapate sung panin Asher in thupha ngah pen ahi hi; a sanggamte in amah pahtawi henla, sathau sungah a khe diah tahen.
Na kulhkongpi kalhnate sik leh sumngo hi ding a, na nuntak laiteng na thahat ding hi.
Na hong huh dingin vantungte’ tungah a tuang, Ama thupitna tawh meii tung a tuang, Yeshurun’ Pa tawh a kibang Khat zong om lo hi.
Tawntung Pa pen nangma kibukna hi a, tawntung bante in a nuailam panin hong dom hi. Amah in na mai panin na galte hawlkhia ding a, ‘Susiamang un,’ ci ding hi.
Tua tak ciangin Israyl guak lungmuang takin teng ding a, Yaaqob suante pen vantungte in daitui a khiatna, an leh leenggahzu thak kicinna gam ah a teng ding uh hi.

Israyl aw, nang thupha hong kipia hi! Yahweh in a hotkhiat nang tawh a kibang kua om ahi hiam? Amah pen nang hong huh na kidalna-lum leh a thupi na namsau ahi hi. Na mai panun na galte un hong kihta mahmah ding a, note in amau’ munsangnate na tuancil ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Moab leitamzang panin Mosheh paito-in Yericho gal, Nebo Mual-a Pisgah dawnah kahto hi. Tua lai mun panin Yahweh in Gilead gam panin Dan ciang dong, gam khempeuh a lak hi.
Naphtali gam khempeuh, Ephraim leh Menasheh-te gam teng, Yahdah gam khempeuh nitumna-lam tuipi; Mediterranean, dong,
Negev leh Yericho Kuam leitamzang panin tua kiim buppi, nisuh singkungte’ khuapi pan Zoar ciang dong a lak hi.

Tua khit ciangin Yahweh in ama kiangah, “Hih pen Keimah in, ‘Na suanlekhakte tungah ka pia ding hi,’ ci-in ka gen lai-in, Abraham, Isaac leh Yaaqob-te tungah kiciamna tawh ka ciam gam ahi hi. Keimah in hih gam, na mit tawh kong musak a, ahih hangin tua lai ah na pai kha kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh in a gensa bang teekteekin Moab gam sung tua lai mun ah Yahweh nasempa Mosheh a si hi.
Yahweh in Moab gam sung Beth Peor gal-a kuam sungah amah vui hi; ahih hangin tu ni dong a han omna kuamah in thei lo hi.
Mosheh a sihin kum 120 a pha hi. A mitte maang loin, a tha ngeina leh a hatna zong kiam lo hi.
Kahna leh thuumna hun a bei dong Mosheh hangin Moab leitamzang ah Israyl mite ni sawm thum sung kapin a thuum uh hi.

Mosheh in ama tungah a khut ngakhin ahih manin, tu-in Nun’ tapa Yahshua pen Kha pilna tawh kidim hi. Tua ahih manin Israyl mite in ama’ thu ngai uh a, Yahweh in Mosheh a thupiaksa bangin a gamta uh hi.
Yahweh in maitang kituah-a a theih Mosheh tawh a kibang kamsang tua huna kipan Israyl sungah om nawn lo hi.
Amah pen Egypt gama Pharaoh tung, a uliante khempeuh tung, leh a gam buppi tungah piandang limte leh nalamdangte a hih dingin Yahweh in a sawl kamsangpa ahi hi.
Tua huna kipan Israyl khempeuh muhna ah a thahat vangliatna a lak ahih keileh Yahweh’ sawlna tawh piandang limte leh nalamdangte a bawl kuamah om ngei nawn lo hi.
